title: Excellent design, top performer
text: I am seriously impressed with this design. Build quality is excellent, it offers lots of great features, and it's very easy to install and operate. This system boasts an incredible stack of filters and moves a lot of air. Being able to wall mount it is a huge bonus, and getting a front panel that is decorated with beautiful artwork takes it to a whole new level. On that note, i do wish they would omit the "mood light" from the front panel on the artist series, as that just takes away from the beauty of it a little bit. Also, why use a black power cord, knowing it will hang down and look unsightly? Minor nitpicks overall, certainly not enough to reduce my overall happiness with the machine. The thing is very intelligent - you can see it kick into higher speed if you just spray anything in the room, or smack a dog pillow - it detects the impurities, and increases fan speed until air quality is back to good levels, then reduces back to lower speeds. While running at lower speeds, it's so silent you cannot hear it at all. Only when impurities are detected can it be heard, but only a faint white noise. We run a white noise generator in our bedroom, which is way louder than this purifier, even when running at its highest speed. I am really happy with this purifier, and will be purchasing another one for the 1st floor of our home.

title: Lamp seems really nice, but I have concerns
text:
I bought one of these lamps in April 2014 directly off the Verilux website. My mother-in-law has one of these lamps and I was very impressed with it so I decided to get one. My overall impression at first was that it was a very well designed lamp. But after I used it for a while I noticed that the plastic tray was very wobbly and tends to work loose, so that I have to tighten it up frequently. This is very annoying, especially in a lamp that seems well designed otherwise, but I could live with it. But in March of 2015 the lamp developed a problem where the light began going off regularly while it was still turned on. I tried a new bulb but it didn't fix the problem. I also noticed a burning odor when the lamp was turned on. Then one day I noticed it seemed smokey around the base of the lamp, which was still working, and that the base felt hot. So I took the plastic plate off the bottom of the lamp to see what the problem was and discovered a plastic box with electronics in it, and the plastic box was partially melted. I figured this box was probably a ballast resister for the light and checked the Verilux web site to see if a replacement is available, but none is listed.

I called Verilux and explained the problem to them. They looked up my order on their website and said my lamp was still under the 1 year warranty, so they sent me a prepaid label to return the lamp to them so that they could inspect it.. A couple weeks later I received a new lamp at no cost. If the story ended here the rating would have been at least 4 stars, but I'm still concerned that replacement parts do not seem to be available once the lamp is out of warranty, and these are not off the shelf parts you can buy at a hardware store. It gets worse. While unpacking the new lamp I noticed the same burning odor around the base of the new lamp that the old lamp had made, and this was before I had even plugged the lamp in. So now I've got the new lamp plugged in, and you guessed it - the burning odor has gotten worse, and I've noticed that the base on this lamp also gets noticeably warm after it is on for a while. I'm not surprised since it smelled pretty bad before I ever turned it on but I am extremely disappointed. Aside from the very annoying burning electronics odor and the warm base the lamp seems to work OK, at least for now. I hoped the odor would go away after a few days but it is getting worse with use rather than better. I've considered sending this lamp back for another replacement but at this point I'm feeling pretty disgusted with this lamp, and with florescent lamps in general. I'm now taking a close look at LED floor reading lamps to see if there are any that I like.

Note that I give Verilux customer service 5 stars for their efforts to fix this problem because they have been excellent to work with. But having had 2 problem lamps in a row received from the company nearly a year apart, I'm greatly concerned about the quality of the lamp itself.

I should also note that at the time I bought my lamp originally I also bought one for my wife and she hasn't had any problems with hers, aside from the plastic tray being kind of flimsy, but I do use my lamp a lot more than she uses hers.

Note attached photo showing the melted area of the plastic box and a circuit board with a dark brownish substance on the bottom in the area where the plastic melted. This is from the first lamp that I returned, and the second lamp is still very new.

Conclusion: What I like: Customer service at Verilux has been top notch and easy to work with. The lamp is well weighted and balanced so it is very stable. The height is adjustable and the neck of the lamp bends so the head of the lamp can be moved around so that it is just perfect. I like that the lamp has a low and a high setting. I especially like the cover over the bulb that shields the glare of the lamp and puts the light only where I want it. The lamp puts out good light for reading or working on detailed projects. The pole of the lamp is very sturdy and overall the lamp looks attractive.

What I don't like: The flimsy plastic tray is a real disappointment in an otherwise very sturdy and well designed lamp. I don't like that I'm having the same burning electronics smell in the second lamp that I had with the first lamp, (and the second lamp had the odor before I even plugged it in). I don't like that the box with the circuit board (ballast resister?) has been such a problem for me yet doesn't seem to be replaceable once the lamp is out of warranty(part seems to be unique to this lamp and is not available on the website, and is hard wired in, not easily removable), as a lamp costing $100 IMHO should be easily repairable with reasonably priced and readily available parts.

If Verilux were to fix these issues this would easily be a 5 star product.

text:
I would allow myself to start this review by saying that the product is of a superb quality. Previously, I was purchasing this product packed in carton boxes. This time, I decided to buy it in a bulk to give my family and friends, too. Original image posted on the Amazon web site pictured the product nicely packed in a big tin jar. I loved it! However, when the product arrived, I was extremely disappointed since it came loosely packed in a non-sealed plastic bag. I looked at the product's picture and found nothing indicating that this picture was placed "for advertisement purpose only". I raised my concerns with Amazon and the Seller. To make the story short, contacting the Seller's representative was not the most pleasant experience of my life. This is what I received in response to my polite comment on the package being different from what I saw on the Amazon site: "... the photo shown was to show the packets that are advertised, that is why there is no mention of any special packaging. ... Had I sent the tin with about 200 packets, you would have referred to the wording rather than the picture. In this case, you received exactly what was described." To re-phrase, it was suggested that I cannot be satisfied [as a customer] no matter what! Forget about the "customer is always right" rule - it doesn't exist anymore.
Bottom line: excellent product, lousy people. What really bothers me is that when the company stops caring about its customers, sooner or later, the product's quality may/will go down the drain... It is just the matter of time...

title: Quackery - Don't buy
text: This is pure quackery. You are buying water at $15 per 1.5 liters....that is insane. Please get an education in basic chemistry. One of the responses to a question in this listing says that "The formula of the water is not H2O, but H2nOn. " That makes no sense whatsoever. H2O is the water molecule. H2O2 is hydrogen peroxide.  H2nOn is meaningless. And liquid oxygen only exists at -279F. There is no 'liquid oxygen' in that bottle. You MAY be getting aerated water but you get that from the water tap in your house. It's no different. Don't be duped, learn basic chemistry and tell this seller to stop hoodwinking people.

title: Improvement in my neck
text:
I initially bought this product at a discount in exchange for a review from my dad, but after discovering that it contains soy, which my dad is allergic to, I decided to take this for a few days to see if it had any effect on the stiffness and arthritis in my neck and upper back. After the 3rd day I noticed that my neck isn't as stiff in the morning when I get out of bed and my arthritis pain goes away much quicker as my morning gets started. It normally takes 30 minutes for me to get warmed up for the day and my pain lasts for a couple of hours, but for the last few days it has only taken 10-15 minutes to loosen up and my pain is greatly reduced within that same time period. So far I've been taking 2 rounded scoops before I go to bed, but I think I'll try 3 and see if I notice a difference. Improvement in my neck stiffness/pain could be a coincidence, but it's probably not since I've tried other things over the years that didn't help much. Since I've only been taking this for a week, my results may just be the tip of the iceberg. I'd love to get out of bed with no stiffness/pain in my neck!

Edit: It's Feb 1st and my neck is still stiff and painful when I wake up.

title: Unhappy Customer
text:
These light bulbs were NOT packaged properly and one of them (ordered two as required replacements for the Northern Light Lamp) was broken. While I realize this is the fault of amazon warehouse procedures as I later learned from amazon customer service, I still had to spend MY time to pack both of the light bulbs AND get instructions from amazon and then had to PRINT out the return address label as well as an invoice from amazon. Then I had to take the package to an UPS Store and send it back to amazon. Northern Light needs to be very clear about the very fragile nature of their light bulbs so customers are not inconvenienced and disappointed as I was, and have their products packed with much more care. Secondly, amazon did not want to credit my account for the light bulbs but the customer svc rep. (whose words I could barely understand) said they would send me replacement bulbs instead. I took the package to UPS and got a tracking number/receipt. When the other 2 light bulbs arrived in about 4 days, we installed them into the Northern Technology Lamp and both of them flickered constantly and never provided full light. Evidently they were Defective. So I had to contact amazon cust svc AGAIN and repeat the process to send light bulbs back for a Refund (credit). When amazon sent me an email with the credit, it only gave me my refund for 1 light bulb! Back to the phone with amazon cust svc! This time at least I could understand what she said to me. Oops! Amazon made an error and she said she would have another credit refunded. To this day, two weeks later, I still have not received an email from amazon with the credit/refund on it! I am really at my wits end and when I receive my credit card statement, there had better be 2 credits for the full amount of those defective light bulbs or I will dispute the charges that amazon has made on my credit card. I don't have the time or energy to deal with amazon customer svc!
By the way, those light bulbs cost almost $30 each! I was able to purchase a New Lamp from another company for $80! That is only $20. more than those 2 light bulbs.
In the future, I am going to be much more careful about buying things from amazon. Not a happy customer of amazon. Better to deal with the company directly.

title: What did you do to my Simply Saline Menthol!!!
text:
I gave this product 5 stars a couple of years ago because it is a very helpful and comforting formula for my terrible sinus problems. I just got in 3 new cans and I noticed a difference in the design in the nozzle in that it was tipped forward a little instead of straight up and down in line with the can. When I used it I got the spray up into my sinuses and then my face, and when I was done I tipped it over and a lot of the liquid ran out of the cap.
When Simply Saline first came out it had a faulty cap that would spray out all openings in the cap: your sinuses, your face, and your clothes. A couple of years ago I found the menthol Simply Saline on Amazon and I took a chance on it and right away I noticed the design of spray nozzle was different, and I was also greatly pleased to find that when I sprayed it it only went where the nozzle was aimed- a fantastic improvement. This is especially important and helpful when I irrigate my sinuses because, as it says on the bottle, you spray with your head tilted to the side and until fluid comes back out. This can take several seconds.
I just tried this with the new can and even though I got my sinuses irrigated I also had it flooding out from the cap and onto the floor where it doesn't do anyone any good.
I'm very disappointed now with the product delivery design and I noticed that it was manufactured in a different place than it was a couple of years ago, so I don't know if the original company was taken over by new management or not. I don't know how you messed it up, but I am going to have second thoughts now of ever purchasing it again and just go back to the nettie pot. Maybe I'll just empty the cans into a nettie pot and be done with it.
Come on, I know you can do better. You've done it before, so do it again.

title: These are perfect for not getting your hands dirty!
text:
I participated in a gut biome study a while back and these were part of their stool sample collection kits. I thought they were super nifty and made collecting the stool sample far less disgusting than I'd envisioned it would be.
AND THEN

My 8 year old kid, who is definitely old enough to know better than to put coins in her mouth, put a quarter in her mouth and then, of course, accidentally swallowed it. She had some chest pain so we went to the ER and had some Xrays where we saw the coin hovering in her esophagus. She ate some food and then we had more Xrays and then we saw it was in her stomach.
I know what experienced parents are thinking and yes, *usually* the coins go through with no problem. But this was a quarter and the doc was slightly more concerned about it making its way through her digestive system without getting caught, so we were instructed to check every poop to verify the coin passed.
We tried using a metal detector at first, but it is surprisingly cumbersome to dial in to the proper sensitivity and to keep the stupid sensor hovered at just the right distance above the poopy water. Then I remembered using these awesome, fantastic, splendidly wonderful poop hammocks for the gut microbacteria study I'd participated in and, of course, found them on Amazon. Hovering that metal detector over the piles of voided material was easy peasy! It was also much easier to chopstick my way through the patty when we finally got that "beep beep beep" to verify the coin than I imagine it would've been to do in a bowl of water.

Anyway, these are great and you should probably just get them if you've come looking for a thing like this.

title: Great for Eyeshadow Application
text:
Purchased this product in October 2018 and it's been quite the investment for me in the long run. I hate to review things without actually testing them out, and for me 2 years is sufficient enough. This facial mister is super easy to use, and refill. After connecting it to a powered USB cord, the light inside turns red when the battery is low/ in need of charging, and when it goes green it means it's fully charged. However, when using it, the light is blue. I find that it's easy to charge and charges quickly. After all this time, I'm genuinely surprised at how long it's lasted and am grateful for it's longevity. Mind you, I've left this unused and uncharged for months at a time, and it still keeps going once the battery is replenished. Made the mistake of purchasing others before this one. One that broke after a few WEEKS of minimal use, and the seller has since disappeared. Lesson learned. If you want a facial mister that is rechargeable and lasts a good amount of time, then look no further. Not sure how they're manufacturing them now as I can see how some reviewers are saying theirs broke too soon. I hope that isn't the case because this is my favorite, and I've tried several.

Tip: If you're someone who enjoys eyeshadows, instead of using setting sprays to spritz your brush before packing on an ultra shimmery/sparkly/glittery shadow, just use water in a mister instead. The droplets don't completely drench your brush, what you're left with is enough water to keep the makeup from flying and getting into your eye. I use mine almost everyday for this purpose and I love it for that.

title: Works as described.
text: I purchased this product after watching Dr. Gundry’s video about gut health. I have been dealing with severe spastic colon for the majority of my life. I haven’t had a solid bowel movement in many, many years. I could tell you where every bathroom in town is!!  I thought “it’s worth a try”!  When I got my order, I immediately started, mixing it in water. I could barely finish it because of the taste. I don’t know how others are saying it’s tasteless, it’s not. I had to figure out what I was going to use to mix it with since I had purchased 3 bottles!  I found Crystal Light lemonade to be tolerable and I’m not adding any sugar by using it. I’m just completing week two and have noticed a huge difference in my bowels, solid and regular. Such a new concept for me!  For that, I’m so grateful to this product. On the negative side, I have gained 4 pounds and remain bloated, no matter what I eat. This is discouraging since I’ve read that people are less bloated and losing weight. I am not a junk food person and we try to eat pretty clean. I’m hoping that it’s just taking me longer to see those effects. I’m 52 and already have to watch what I eat so the extra weight isn’t sitting well with me.  I’ll will continue to take this because the stomach issues I’ve had in the past are the main reason and I’m liking being “regular”!

title: Take your time!
text:
The product works great but I would advise taking your time and don't force it.
I trimmed the brush to about an inch over the corner to corner dimensions of my chimney. That was almost 4" of excess! There is no good reason to need that much other than potentially binding up the brush and snapping one of the rods. It cleaned perfectly.
While I appreciate the push button quick disconnect on the rods, this is not a process where speed is a concern. There were multiple times I gave the connections a quick tug before sending them up and they pulled right apart. That button has to be PERFECTLY seated to hold and the tolerance from hold to release is VERY small.
I would suggest the manufacturer switch to an allen-keyed set screw instead. Screw it in to disconnect, screw it out to tighten. Yes it would require an extra 30 seconds to assemble and disassemble, but nothing would be more catastrophic in this process than having a rod disconnect halfway through, leaving the brush and remaining rods stranded in your chimney.
Try to imagine THAT rescue plan!

title: ... roller was shipped promptly and arrived on time in perfect condition. I very much like that it comes ...
text:
My roller was shipped promptly and arrived on time in perfect condition.
I very much like that it comes with an instruction booklet, as I knew what it was intended for, but I hadn’t used one before and didn’t know any specific exercises. The booklet has very clear instructions, accompanied by pictures to show exercises for a variety of muscle groups.

I really like the size of this roller. The diameter is not too big and not too small. Just right to allow it to be used for lots of areas on the body. The length seems very appropriate as well. It is a convenient size to carry around. I use it at the gym, and it fits nicely in my gym bag. Also, the I can feel that it is very strong, but despite this, it is surprisingly light.

I run and do spin classes. I use it before spin classes to stretch out my legs and glutes, and after both runs and spin classes to massage muscles. The effect is very noticeable. My legs feel so much less tight the following day, which is particularly good when I train on consecutive days. Before I was using my roller, if I ran one day and cycled the next, I would really struggle with the cycling. Stretching and massaging with the roller has hugely helped with this.

This was a great buy. So worth it at that price. I would happily recommend it to anyone.

I had been meaning to try a hair brush straightener for a while since I've seen really good Amazon and Youtube reviews of them, and I saw this one (and a couple other brands) on sale during Amazon Prime Day so I took the leap and bought this one. Normally, it can take anywhere from an hour to an hour and a half to straighten my long, curly hair (3b spiral curls, hair down to belly button when straight) with a flat iron. Using this hair brush straightener at 450 degrees, I finished my hair in about 27 minutes the first time, and that's including the time to clip and unclip different sections of hair and some brushing to detangle! I did still need to use a flat iron for finishing touches since it's hard to get the roots and tips with the brush, but this has been by far the fastest and easiest hair straightening process I've ever had.

title: Nice. And new but feels a little used and abused.
text:
Sitting on the table, I would give this case an easy four stars. It is a very good looking piece. The parts are properly cut and match well. The handles and latch are sturdy and equally nice looking. The design is attractive. But it is not without a few faults.

When I pulled the bottom drawer open, the front panel of the drawer almost pulled completely off because it is only held on with glue but the glue didn't hold.

The divider assembly in the top tier had also come unglued. This is no problem since it does not affect function. Indeed, it might be considered a feature since it makes it removable.

The description states that you can fit 4 oz bottles in the bottom drawer. This was a deciding factor in choosing this case because I have several 4 oz bottles and most oil cases don't provide for bottles this size. Well, neither does this one. Perhaps the implication was that you could lay the bottles on their side. If so, then that contradicts the description, which clearly states that you never have to worry about oils spilling or staining because the bottle will always be held upright. And you could only fit 3 bottles on their side but 8 would fit upright. On a side note, the unfinished inside surface is highly porous and will easily absorb oil.

Another misrepresentation in the description states that this case is "durable." That's not the word I would use. It is made from thin, low quality plywood. If this case is dropped, it will not fare well.

They do offer a money-back, satisfaction guarantee but I won't be returning it. It does look very nice, I can glue the drawer, I don't mind the loose divider or the porous wood, and hopefully I won't put it to a durability test. I'm disappointed that 4 oz bottles won't fit upright but, to be honest, I didn't expect them to because the photos just don't make it look like they would. I've already ordered and received another case that will hold even my 8 oz bottles (and that case is very durable, with high quality construction).

It would straighten, but my ends would be super frizzy because there wasn't enough tension for the brush to keep a good grip and do the ends well. It also took just as long as straightening, if not more. I tried it 4 times, freshly showered hair, 2nd day hair, hair with heat protectant, and 2nd day curly hair with mouse in it, my results were bad all around. While I like the concept of having more body in my hair when straight, this was only volumous because of the frizzy ends. Overall very disappointed, sending it back. My advice, spend 1/2 as much money on a different brand because ultimately this is still a device from China, then if it doesn't work your only out $20 instead of $50.

title: Yes, It Works
text: Bought a vintage Seiko via The Auction Site You Already Know About. Knew it had a few hairline scratches in the crystal, but nothing I couldn't live with, which was before I proceeded to put a non-ignorable large scratch in said crystal. Did the requisite Google search for dealing with mineral-crystal scratches (I think this Seiko was pre-Hardlex by a year or two), and came across a YouTube video demonstrating this very PolyWatch kit, and I immediately ordered said kit. Long-story-short, if works as advertised, but here's pro tip via that YouTube video: you can save yourself a lot of elbow-grease if you (CAREFULLY) use a Dremel tool to apply the pastes included in the kit to the crystal. I followed the suggestions, and was amazed at the results. 100% effective? My mileage says at least 95%, and that's with close inspection. On the day-to-day watch-glance, it's essentially perfect. (Won't work with sapphire crystals, but in theory, you'd never need to worry about sapphire unless you shattered it, no?) Highly recommended.

I've wicked multiple builds in the 2 1/2 weeks that I've had this cotton, and vaped the begeezuz out of them with no problems, hit after hit, day after day, chain vaping, wutrver and I haven't gotten one single dry hit and it doesn't get burn either, this stuff wicks great, last long, and the flavor and clouds it produces is insane, obviously a lot of that has to due with the coil ur vaping to, but this cotton, compared to others is all around much much better. I've tried tons of other wicks, cotton bacon, native wicks, organic pads, those crappy shoelace style wicks, and plenty others, and I have to say this is probably hands down the BEST wick I've ever tried. title: the dogs and I are pleased
text:
I have two small spaniels, female, who are puppy-mill-breeder rescues. One came from a terrible mill and has all sorts of trauma, both physiological and emotional. Her back end is very weak; her rear legs tremble all of the time. As you might imagine, she has big incontinence problems - due partly to physical weakness, but also, and in large part, to terrific anxiety and nervousness. After five and a half years of cleaning up puddles and breaking my neck to get her outside every hour, I came across these pills - a little over a month ago. Her problem peeing has disappeared. Like magic. I cannot believe it. I give her three or four pills in her meals, twice a day, and two more when I go to bed, as she will have to get through my sleep hours.

My sister told me about tea pills; her holistic doctor recommended them to balance her yin and yang. I do not know whether dogs have yins and yangs, but my little spaniel seems calmer and happier now, as well as being able to stay dry. As a result, my yin and yang have improved greatly.

Also, my other spaniel, who used to be completely reliable, started having little episodes on the kitchen rug several months ago - possibly because she is getting old. Now I give her two pills twice a day, and there have been no more episodes.

Again, these are small dogs: one weighs about sixteen pounds, the other around twenty. No idea whether larger dogs would need more. The recommended dose for humans is eight pills, three times daily.

title: Better than a Yeti... or anything else!
text: I'm a coffee mug connoisseur of sorts, and own too many to count, because I'm always looking for one that suits all of my practical needs. This mug is wonderful! The most important features to me are: ease of carrying (both lids have a handle!), keeps my coffee hot (once poured directly from the carafe, it's still piping hot 6 hours later and warm for at least TEN HOURS), won't turn over (it fits in my cars cup holder!), flexibility (two lids- one for drinking, one canteen style), no spills (the seals on the lid are definitely watertight), and solid construction that won't allow water to seep between parts to inevitable leak on something later (never once happened).  I've been using this daily since it was delivered and and am so happy. I am not the type to shell out extra money for a name brand vacuum sealed stainless steel coffee mug, but even the Yeti cups don't interest me because of their flimsy lids. This mug/canteen is absolutely perfect because it hits all the marks above, and stores enough coffee for me to have a still-hot afternoon cup of good home-brewed coffee instead of the day-old cheap swill they have at the office. Plus, I can carry it any way and anywhere-- I literally clipped it (with a carbiner) onto my *white* bag while wearing *white* pants last week and didn't even worry a bit about the coffee sloshing inside while I walked into and around work. This is the mug you're looking for, I'm sure. The little drawstring bag is a nice bonus, but this mug has been amazing! If anything ever happens to it (this seems unlikely, other than theft or accident), I'll buy the exact same thing again and again!!

title: I couldn't decide so I tried all 6.
text:
I had been using Manduka's mat wash, but the idea of using something more natural appealed to me. I purchased the 6 bottle deal because it was the best value, and I wanted to try a few scents. Although not all of the scents deserve a 5 star rating (in my opinion), their cleaning ability, natural ingredients, and the included microfiber towel make up for a couple of misses in the fragrances.

Obviously, the appeal of a scent is very subjective, but this is what worked for me and what did not.

5 Stars: Soothing Sweet Rose
I normally hate floral scents. In fact perfume gives me migraines. This has none of the typical cloying smells that are generally found in floral-scented products. The rose smells like what you would find in a garden, not on a store shelf. The scent is not overpowering, but it is strong enough to be enjoyed while using the mat. This quickly became my favorite out of all of the bottles, and I wish I could buy just this scent in a 6 pack.

5 Stars: Energizing Peppermint
This is a close second to the rose scent. It is refreshing but not overwhelming; in fact, the scent is fairly faint, even while being applied. It is just enough to notice during savasana.

4 Stars: Uplifting Eucalyptus
I HATED this scent when I first tried it. My first thought was that I had just coated my mat with the equivalent of Vicks VapoRub. I was wondering how to get the stench off of the mat before I began my practice, and the only positive I could come up with was that it might be nice if I used it when I had a cold. Surprisingly, once it dried, the scent was really pleasant. The medicine smell dissipated, and what was left was enjoyable even through extended Child's Pose.

1 Star: Calming Citrus
This was one of the scents that I expected to like the most, and the scent literally made me feel nauseous. It smelled like I had doused my mat in 409. Despite the natural ingredients (and yes, I double checked that nothing artificial had been slipped into this bottle), it was overpowering and artificial smelling. I think this could be salvaged with the addition of a ginger scent, but as it is, it is unbearable.

I didn't try the lavender since I purchased that for my daughter, but it seems like enough other reviews have covered that anyway. I haven't tried the unscented either since I enjoy the other scents too much to take a break from them for now.

title: It’s good to have a sublingual option
text: I recently finished my first ever bottle of this product. This is a good option to ease into using Serrapeptase if you have never used it before. It’s also a good option for those who cannot tolerate the capsules. Serrapeptase is powerful stuff and and the capsules can cause very unpleasant side effects like nausea, headaches, and dizziness in first-time users. It’s best to start slow and in small doses. Although this product claims to have the same effectiveness as 120,000 SU capsules, that is simply not true, but it does have an effect. It’s just a mild one, and that makes it a great way to ease into using Serrapeptase.  When I started using this, I had never used Serrapeptase in any form before. I wanted to heal my painful fibrocystic breasts and as a side bonus clear up my allergy-induced sinus issues. I tried the recommended dose (two pumps a day)with no effect whatsoever. I increased to a second dose per day then a third dose—taking a dose (two pumps) roughly every 8 hours. Still no noticeable effects. But the bottle says each dose gives only 3500SU and so 3 doses was still only about 10,000SU per day. So I began taking a double dose (4 pumps) 3 times a day to get 20,000SU. At that dose my sinus issues were about 75% improved, but no effect on breast pain. Still no side effects, however, the taste is not pleasant and when you use that much a day the taste becomes overwhelming! I realized I needed something stronger for my breast pain, so I began using 45,000SU capsules. The first time I took one (on an empty stomach) I knew they were much stronger than this spray. Within 30 minutes the Serrapeptase hit my blood stream and I felt woozy and had a slight headache for several hours. At that point I was very grateful to this sublingual product for helping me work up a tolerance for Serrapeptase very gradually. I’m sure that if I had started with the capsules first, my side effects would have been much worse. I was able to adjust to the capsules by taking one every other day and using this product on the days I didn’t use the capsules until the side effects of the capsules lessened. The capsules do a better job of completely clearing my sinuses and also lessening breast pain. I hope eventually the fibrocystic breast disease will heal thanks to Serrapeptase. I did recently try some 120,000SU capsules and that dose causes my to get a bad headache and feel dizzy for hours. There’s no way that two pumps of this stuff is that strong! However, I am glad this stuff is not that strong or I couldn’t use it!

title: Primal Supplements at an amazing value!
text:
I've ascribed to the primal/keto lifestyle for about two years and while I've tried a bunch of the primal kitchen products I hadn't invested in any of the supplements until I saw this bundle on Amazon. I've tried variants of all of the products by other brands and I'll touch on all of them briefly.
Primal Fuel - Tastes amazing with close to zero protein flavor and, in my opinion, no aftertaste to speak of. Good combination of vitamins and minerals, satiating, excellent meal replacement.
Master Formula - One of the BEST multi vitamins I've tried. 12 capsules a day but I've yet to find a product I trust the quality of with so much packed in. Conveniently packaged in easy to grab travel ready packs.
Primal Probiotics - I felt the difference in how well I handled different foods while taking these as well as a general improvement I'm overall health. The benefits of healthy micro biome are extensive and these definitely help with improving your gut.
Primal Sun - This vitamin D supplement is not like I thought, a white powder in a capsule as opposed to a liquid in a gold colored gelcap. No complaints
Primal Omegas - These are pretty potent and aren't too large. There is a little bit of fish burp but I found it to be far less when taken in the middle of a meal and even without food, it's not that bad and doesn't last long at all.

Final assessment, I would absolutely purchase any of these products individually and the fact that all of these products are available in one bundled package at such a great price just ups the value. Try this bundle, you won't be disappointed.

Cons:

I like this mask for use when traveling or napping. If you are using it for sleeping each night then this may not be right for you.
The material these are made out of is great. It breathes well and blocks out the light except for around the nose area. Maybe I ordered the wrong nose bridge one, but how are you suppose to know which one to order? Wish they provided a little more information on how to tell.

The mask is formed away from your eyes which also works great. You can open and shut your eyes without them touching the mask. The strap in the back is elastic with a Velcro connection which is a few inches long. It would be nice if it was longer to accommodate more sizes. That being said, I personally didn't have problems with it. The mask comes in a nice plastic bag which is a plus.

The ear plugs are not very good for repeated use. I like that they have a case, but these are the foam (usually throw away) kind. Would be nice to see a more quality pair of reusable ones.

Overall this mask work well for travel or napping which is why I purchased it. If you need a mask to sleep each night then you may want to look into a more expensive one. For my purposes, I would recommend this. I received this product at a discounted price for my review. title: Attractive design, but not designed for everyone
text:
I bought three different kinds of 7 day / 4 times of day med organizers for my folks, and this was one of them. We kept this one, but I'm still not certain it's the best one for my folks' situation. (If I'd been able to find the EZY-Dose 4 a day / Weekly in Large, which NOW Amazon has, that would have been a serious contender. We'd found the medium but its compartments were too small.)

Pros:

- The pill compartments are good-sized and can hold Dad's two "horse pills" in one slot. The dividers can be rearranged, too, to make bigger slots (leaving fewer times per day).

- You can take out the pill bays to take with you if you won't be home when it's time for pills, and you're not stuck carrying the whole shebang.

- It has an attractive design that doesn't scream "pills!"

- It is so much easier to fill than the kind with individually hinged lids. Take off their lids, and plop plop plop!

Cons:

- The lid of the carrier case that holds the 7 individual pill bays is colored plastic, as are the lids of the individual pill bays. That means if you have the case closed, you're looking through two layers of colored plastic to see if you've taken your pills. If you order online where you're taking a chance on the color you get, you risk getting the smokey grey. With that color, it's going to be harder to see whether the pills were taken without lifting the carrier case lid, because the two layers of colored plastic are hard to see through. (Having just had it fall out of the cabinet, I'm glad the lid was there -- the bays would have popped open if they hadn't been in a case.) The picture shown for the product on Amazon showing the aqua one shows aqua's sheerness pretty accurately. I've seen aqua, fluorescent yellow, and smokey grey in person, and the first two are very easy to see through.

- If you're buying this product for a senior or someone with less manual dexterity, it may be too easy to accidentally uncover too much of a slot and dump out pills from another time frame. I told my mom to try to uncover only half the slot she needed so she wouldn't accidentally get pills from the next time slot.

- If you're buying this for a senior or someone with less mental dexterity, the lack of labelling may be confusing. I wish they'd provided labels to stick in the bays to help with when pills get taken. I lined the bottoms of the bays with strips of papers on which I'd written the times each set gets taken.

title: Very useful, stable, overbed table
text:
This table is excellent.

I bought this table for multiple uses. For the most part, we don't need a medical bed table per se, but we do benefit from it.
Personally, I've only been in the hospital for births, so really only positive expereinces. The 2 things I've always missed when coming home are the adjustable bed, and the super handy overbed tables.

This is why I purchased the table. It's handy. I've used it to work on my computer in bed, study and write notes. Sometimes it's nice to be able to snuggle with a chld while helping them them with a lesson. In the past, I've used lap desks, and they work, but you can't more, iwhen you do mov you have to reconfigure the lab desk and re-stabalize it. Wiht a wiggly kid, that can be nearly impossible.

The pverbed table is perfect, it rolls under the bedframe so that you can positition the table where you need it.

WE LOVE it. My husband already wants one for his side of the bed too.. (yes he gets to borrow mine)

The table itself is very sturdy. It lists a 40 pound limit. I've not tried to test that, but it feels like it would handle fine.
It was not hard to assemble. There are 6 screws to hold the main mount to the table.
The caster wheels simple push in - just make sure the locking wheels are on the long pols side so that they are outside the bed, but under it if you want to lock them.)
Then there is a screw that needs to be removed to allow the height adjustment to work, and then a very small one to put in it's place.

The height adjust works flawlessly. It goes up quite high. Our bed is pretty high to begin with so I was a little concerned, but it does lift high enough for our bed.

The table moves smoothly on the caster wheels. I would trust having food or a drink on it and moving it around. It's does not bounce or shake as it's moved. We do have low carpet in our bedroom as well and it rolls just fine with good stability.

The only minor issue I had with the table - 1 of the 6 pre-drilled holes for the screws that attach to the table was not drilled right. For now, I installed 5 screws - the missing one is not on a corner, which makes it less of a concern). When he has time I will let my husband install the last screw. It's plenty stable though, without it.

I would love to use this table in my living-room, but unfortunately at the moment out couches are very very low to the ground and this could not fit under them. I've never seen any type of table that has a small enough base to slide under these couches. This is in no way a reflection of this product, it's not intended to work under any couch and ours is especially low to the ground. I just love the table enough that I wish I could use it there too.

If one of us did need to spend an extended period of time in bed, this would be an invaluable tool. I can't recommend it enough for anyone that it's essentially bed ridden or mostly immobile.

title: These are neither an orthotic, nor do they provide arch support
text:
It's ok.

Honestly, this is not what I was expecting or hoping for. The size is fine. It's states that thes7e are 24cm long up to size 6 shoe, which would be a 7-8 woman's shoe when you jump from kids/mens sizing over to woman's/

I bought this pair more for our 14yo daughter who wears a 6-7 woman's shoe, or if she didn't like it or ift her, out youngest wears a kids 2, so I knew I oculd cut it down for him.

So, really the size is fine. But, I think MOST poeple looking for a kid's insole probably want the small or med and probably want to err more on the smaller side -ordering smaller not bigger in THIS item for kids near the line of 2 sizes.

ok, so, I'm disappointed because it's listed as an "Orthtotic Sports Insole Arch and Comfort Support". Two works stook out to me when chooising what to buy. ORTHOTIC and ARCH Support. My kids all have very flat feet, with ankle pronation and other effects from the lack of internal arch support. I do try to buy them shoes with support, and like to have inserts to help, especially with shoes that are severly lacking.

The Arch support in these insoles is frankly pathetic. The blue you see in the pucture is what provides the "Arch support" it's a very thin, very light plactic that doesvnot hold shape with any reasonalble pressure.

The create a real arch support you have to have a firm, relentless plactic that doens't give in to pressure, otherwise, why waste plactic there, other than to look like it's doing something.

I gave them to my daughter to try and she said the insoles are too think, don't really add much for her shoes.

I do like the grippy material on the bottom - wish other insoles had that.

They would work fine in a shoe that is missing it's insoles or really only has a flat piece of thin foam - they are better than that. But, these are NOT an orthotic and do not have any real arch support. A shame really.

I'm not sure if these will get used at all. I don't think my daughter wants to bother with them, and I won't use them for our younger son unless they replace something that provides less support.

title: My first experience growing mushrooms at home.
text:
This was my first time growing mushrooms at home. I used this syringe to inoculate 10 pint size mason jars filled with birdseed/millet. These jars were added to 5 bags of hardwood pellet substrate. All bags colonized completely with no problems accept when I fruited the first bag the oyster mushrooms were long and stringy.

I built a shotgun fruiting chamber out of a clear plastic bin/perlite and then I installed a small 5v USB fan which I purchased on amazon for a couple bucks to help regulate humidity and air exchange. The next bags which were produced from this batch turned out to be very nice mushrooms when fruiting in this new environment. This was a lot of fun and I look forward to purchasing more.

UPDATE: After two flushes I buried the block behind my home in a shaded area. We had some rain and then a temperature drop, and the next day I noticed the nicest flush yet growing of the block which I had buried. I think I will need to increase my air exchange and I might even try to grow some of these oyster mushrooms in buckets outside on a straw substrate.

It is also a nuisance to sleep on the adjustment ties / lump in the back - why not put on forehead as I doubt users sleep face down with a CPAP mask on ...?

For that price the seller should NOT have "reinvented the wheel", but asked an existing cap hat manufacturer to produce a "fit any size" cap for $8-12 without a shade, turned it around so the adjustment would be over the forehead. Then attached the Velcro base using a width twice the width of the chin strap so - depending one ones head size - one can place the chin strap so the Velcro strap ends don't touch and irritate ears. Personally I would have preferred the option to have the chin strap be cloth all the way up and not cloth at bottom with elastic higher up so as to minimize the pressure on my chin and cheeks, yet providing a fixed limit as to how much my mouth/jaw could open.

title: Great marine collagen - sustainability + clean flavor + science
text:
I have been taking a grass-fed bovine based collagen for ~ 9 months and have been okay with it but I decided to try a marine collagen to switch it up. I am so glad I did! First of all, the flavor of this product is MUCH cleaner than the bovine. I was tricking myself into thinking my bovine collagen was taste-free, however it left a savory taste to my black coffee which made me not want to drink it as often. I mixed a scoop of Pure Marine Collagen into my black coffee and WOW. No fish flavor. No savory flavor. It was CLEAN. I was impressed and I'll definitely be adding it on a daily basis! I'll note that it *does* need some stirring but it will go into solution - very similar to bovine options I've tried.

The added benefits that sold me:
(1) from skins of fish caught for human consumption = sustainable
(2) sourced from wild caught fish = ever *more* sustainable!
(3) a website with science!!

- Firstly, I love that this company uses the WHOLE fish. People used to eat fish skins along with the flesh, right? The American diet has been missing out and Pure Marine Collagen helps us add back an important nutrient while reducing waste from fish harvesting - win-win!

- Secondly, the sustainability of farm-raised fish is questionable at best. Farm raised fish have to eat something, and that "something" may come from chickens, cows, or other sources with greater environmental impact. Consuming wild-caught fish (and fish collagen!) is a choice I've made as a consumer. Don't get me wrong, I love a good burger, but 90% of the time I'll choose sustainable if its economical.

- Thirdly, their website lists clinical trials and scientific studies done with collagen. What?!? Rarely do I find a "health" product that backs its potential benefits with RESEARCH. As a food scientist and researcher myself, I am impressed and feel confident that the this company is selling a quality product and rather than duping customers into thinking its a magic elixir. On behalf of all scientists, Thank You, Kenny & Ross!

Do yourself a favor and check this collagen out! The flavor is great - that is, if "great" means non-existent ;)

title: Great Massage
text:
Wow. Usually when you purchase a product that is not from a big name company, the issue seems to be that it is lacking in quality and power. This is the exact opposite of that. This prodcut, the Shiatsu Neck And Back Massager - FitPlus Shiatsu Neck Massager Pillow With 4 Heated KNeading Nodes 2 Year Warranty Car Chair Back Massager Pillow, is probably one of the most, if not the most, powerful massage products I have ever owned.
Now I would not exactly call this a pillow. It is a hard material, and a very well constructed one at that. It contains four roller points, and each one of them delivers a little slice of heaven and relieve to a tired and aching back.
The hard pillow type object has a strap on the back of it so that you can firmly affix it to the back of the chair you are sitting on. This is a very nice feature especially if you are trying to aim for your upper back. For me, it sits perfectly just at my shoulder blades, but you can adjusted to the height on your back that you are trying to make feel better. The unit itself is pretty lightweight and therefore easy enough to adjust, even while it is on.
It came with both AC and DC adapters. I have a massaging seat topper in my car already, so I use this at home at night when I come home from work. Besides, I really feel like this is too powerful of a massage function to be used in the car. It's much more invasive than your average vibrating seat topper. Perhaps if a passenger wanted to use it, that would be one thing, but this unit certainly should not be used while driving.
I have read other people's reviews, and I think it is important to mention that my unit had seemingly no smell at all and the heat function did not bother me at all and it heated very nice and gradually. The heat function seemed to intensify the massage feature, but I think that's a matter of personal preference.
I did receive this product at a discounted rate in exchange for my honest review. This in no way altered my opinion of this awesome product.

title: DO NOT BUY THIS SAUNA - MAJOR DESIGN FLAW - YOU WILL LOSE YOUR $$ - DON'T BE FOOLED BY WARRANTY
text: I purchased this sauna last summer and almost immediately it began to fail. It has a MAJOR design flaw. The cables do not fit into the dome snuggly. Therefore, sometimes the bottom heating unit wouldn't work and sometimes the top heating unit wouldn't work. After five months both domes stopped heating up altogether and it would not longer work. When I set it up initially, I only moved the top dome to slide over the bottom dome 4 times in 5 months, and I never moved the entire sauna once it was set up. So it is not as if I moved it a lot and the cables became loose. They say there is a 2 year warranty, but they don't tell you that you have to ship it to China to get it repaired and YOU have to pay for the shipping which will be hundreds of dollars, just to repair something with a design flaw that is going to break again soon anyways. At first the manufacturers didn't even want to do that and said that I must have moved it around too much. Never mind that it is supposed to be PORTABLE and should be made with enough durability to MOVE AROUND!! And as I mentioned previously, I moved it less than a handful of times in 5 months, so I knew that was not the case. They were trying to renege on their warranty. So don't be reassured by the warranty. You really have little recourse if they say no. Now they are saying they will fix it but I have to pay hundreds of dollars to get it to them, and it likely won't work for long anyways. No thanks. I have since spoken to other people who have owned this sauna and they say the EXACT same thing happened to them. Clearly it is designed poorly and is a low quality product. I'm going to take the loss and purchase a permanent unit so this doesn't happen again. Save yourself the frustration and DO NOT BUY THIS SAUNA!! Worst purchase I have ever made.

The thing is still dark and is sitting glumly on my shelf, just an expensive piece of plastic, laughing at my stupidity. title: I enjoy doing fun new things with my hair
text:
First I'm going to say that I didn't have high expectations for this straightening brush. I thought that there was no way it could work. How would a brush straighten hair? I'm excited to to say that it does. I do need a hair cut so disregard split ends. It's been over a year since I've had a trim. I know, I've just been trying to grow it out. I had a bob in the past.

I enjoy doing fun new things with my hair. Blow drying, straightening, bleaching and funky colors.

The first thing I noticed when I opened the box was that it came with 2 large plastic alligator clips. These clips are amazing for thick hair. I need to purchase these! There is also a thermal protective glove. This is the first time I've used one. It works amazingly well. No more burning my fingers. The brush itself was surprisingly heavy. I'm glad it is otherwise I would probably forget to not use it like a brush!!

A few helpful tips for anyone who isn't used to using hot tools.
1. It's important to remember to use a heat protecting product in your hair when using this tool.
2. Be sure to brush your hair prior to use.
3. Section your hair off.
4. For best results use small sections and hold the ends of hair.
5. Glide through hair slowly.
6. 2 passes should do it
7. Finish hair off with your favorite smoothing product.

Im very pleased with the results.

I did receive a coupon for this product to help facilitate this review. All thoughts are my own.

My hair stylist and doctor couldn't give me any reason for it, or solutions for it. I wa feeling pretty frustrated. I took Das Gro for 2 months. title: Don't Try to Fly with it.
text: I have been using Clear Care for my contacts for at least five years and have been extremely satisfied with it.  The only problem I had was trying to board an airplane and TSA confiscated it.  I recently  read on three different website that TSA will allow you to carry containers more than the standard 4 Oz's as long as it is medicinal.  My wife took an unopened bottle from the Twin Pack and attempted to board a southwest airlines plane. TSA made her throw it out and when she attempted to show them the references on her phone that said you could carry a larger bottle she was told that since it has hydrogen peroxide in it that it was illegal because apparently she could use it to create an explosive device onboard with it.  She had to dispose of it and was told that she couldn't carry any type of contact lense solution that had a red top on it.  She ended up throwing a brand new unopened bottle away and not having any contact lense solution with here.  Now when she lands she has to find a drug store that sells it before she can take out her lenses.  They need to indicate on their bottle that it isn't airline friendly.

title: An Ounce of Prevention....
text:
[[VIDEOID:686bdd359d47437f7536bdecb1c738b0]] When I see a new product that I have not already investigated, I research it for myself. Years ago, that was difficult if you didn't have a bunch of books on hand already. It meant checking out books from the Library and studying things out. We acquired many books and much study material on Health. Presently, it is so much easier to look things up online. It has been said; Ignorance is a choice in the age of the internet.
This brings us to the topic at hand literally, Haha. It is Beta Sitosterol by Spectra Essentials.
I was offered the chance to check out this great supplement at a reduced price and agreed to give an honest review. Well, I already knew of the benefits of taking Bata Sitosterol from listening to Dr. Asa on the radio and from other sources, so I didn't think I needed to research this one.
I already knew it is good for the Prostate and lowering Cholesterol. But what I didn't know is HOW it works. So to the internet I went. I saw all the information on what it does for example; it works as part of a cholesterol-lowering diet. It is good for preventing heart disease and a host of other things. The federal Food and Drug Administration even allows manufacturers to claim that foods containing plant sterol esters, such as beta-sitosterol are good for reducing the risk of coronary heart disease (CHD). This is based on the FDA’s conclusion that plant sterol esters may reduce the risk of CHD by lowering blood cholesterol levels.
So how then, does it work?
Beta-sitosterol is a plant substance similar to cholesterol. It might help reduce cholesterol levels by limiting the amount of cholesterol that is able to enter the body. It can also bind to the prostate to help reduce swelling (inflammation). Now I know that inflammation is a major cause of all manner of illness, so I am all about reducing inflammation. We already don't eat white flour and white sugar products just to prevent disease. My wife and I are in good health. No real health problems. We take no prescription meds. We have always been about prevention.
It is for this reason I will take Beta Sitosterol, to keep from having issues.
Thanks for letting me try this; I have already started on it this morning and feel good about doing good things for the body.

title: so I use a round brush and a blow dryer to get the perfect side sweep
text: If you have curly, wavy, or long hair, this is a life saver. Life changing too. My hair is quite long, and curly. I'm also a busy nurse mom with absolutely no time. My hair is also damaged and dry from lightening it so many times. It takes 3 minutes to heat up, I section my hair in three sections on each side of my head (6 sections total) and take vertical sections and slowly glide the tool from root to end. If you go too fast, it won't straighten properly. If your sections are too big it won't straighten unless you take smaller sections. I get my hair smoothed and straightened in 10 minutes. My side bangs are too short to use this on, so I use a round brush and a blow dryer to get the perfect side sweep. It doesn't over heat and break my hair like most hot tools out there, it's really gentle. I would definitely recommend using a hot tool glove to protect your hands from the heat. I use two gloves, one on each hand so in able to touch everything while styling.

title: Best PC/Gaming glasses
text:
After owning these for sever weeks and trying a few different pairs of Gunnars...I prefer these all the way. They are a typical plastic frame with clear lenses. The frames have a typical curve to them that rest on top of the ears. The lenses seems fully transparent, however, if you place them on top of an iPad screen or right in front of a computer screen you will see a slight brown tint. I actually mistakenly ordered the pair with the 35% as opposed to the 50% that I wanted but after using them I really don't feel as though I need the 50%. They do not provide any magnification at all. The Gunnars all apparently have a +0.02 magnification but somehow that actually did give me a headache. They're lightweight with some flex and have really saved me from tons of headaches (I work on a computer all day and also play video games in the evening. These lenses are great for eyes that do not need prescription, although I believe they are available through the company. Lastly, the only thing I would change has to do specifically to the red ones--the parts that rest over the ears really aren't red but rather a sort of rose color. Not a big issue but it might bother some.

(these also are very comfortable when wearing a gaming headset, I have them on always with Astro A40s)

title: Very solid case

While that may sound like it's weak, it isn't. It's very lightweight, hard case with room for pretty much any shaped glasses. Only thing I would change is a bit thicker lining on the inside.

title: Works, but don't expect miracles.
text:
Used for pontoon boat that had about 8 years of freshwater lake build up. Read directions and mixed the ratio and sprayed it on, but it didn't do too much, and just left it really spotted.
Increased the ratio each time and ended up using a brass soft brush to remove the build up along the water line. Even then it wasn't coming off. This stuff just seemed to turn the lower half water build up darker. After I lightly used the brass brush on the top half, I used it again and it seemed to foam up right away and made the top half a look half decent, but under the water line it didn't seem to work and I pretty much gave up. It did improve the look of the top sections however, and I was able to lower the ugly water line build up with a sander. I would say, if you have a lot of hard water build up, you Will definitely have to increase the ratio by a good bit to get it to do anything.

title: If you love your carpets and want them to last a long time, use a dry chemical cleaner!
text: My carpets are over 20 years old and they still look like new!  If you love your carpets and want them to last a long time, use a dry chemical cleaner to clean your carpets!  This is so easy to use!  Just sprinkle this on your carpets and work them into the carpets using the Host Cleaning machine (rent at a local hardware store).  This machines consists of two cylindrical brushes which works this cleaner into the carpets and deep cleans.  This cleaner is like moist sawdust that clings to dirt and draws it out of your carpets.  After cleaning your carpets, you can walk on it as much as you like.  After about an hour, it will dry and just use your normal vacuum cleaner to vacuum it up.  However, if you want to leave the cleaner on longer, no problem!  Much better than steam cleaning in my opinion as you can never be sure you removed all the soap out of your carpets with steam cleaning and if you didn't, then the soap will attract dirt faster and your carpets will get dirty again much quicker.  You don't have this problem with a dry chemical cleaner.  Tip:  Turn the container upside down 24 hours prior to cleaning your carpets to make sure that the moisture is distributed evenly from top to bottom of the dry chemical cleaner.

title: Not right for me
text:
I’ve been wanting to try probiotics for a while. I’ve read about some of the health benefits (lower cholesterol, weight loss, and digestive health) and I’ve been eager to try them. From the shopping I’ve done I’ve been a little hesitant to experiment since they can be pricey.

I was offered the opportunity to try Premiva Ultra Probiotic for free based on an honest and fair review. After taking the product for 2 weeks, I have to admit that I have lost a few pounds. I don’t know that I can contribute the weight loss to the probiotics explicitly but my diet and exercise has been consistent both before and during taking the product.

However, what I’ve noticed most is that the product seems to have made me feel bloated and gassy. I assumed those effects might go away once my body had became accustomed to the probiotics but the feeling hasn’t diminished. I’m not sure that I’ll continue to take the product. I’m guessing everyone probably reacts differently to probiotics. I just don’t think they’re right for me.

title: Excellent alternative to xanthan gum
text: BulkSupplements’ Pure Guar Gum Powder is finely ground, of a pale mocha-brown color, dense but light; doesn’t clump; has the look and feel of a dried-bean flour; nice smell, but not for eating by itself. It thickens drinks nicely, although it seems to take at least two or three times as much as it would xanthan gum; the xanthan I’ve used is a white, flowing, granular powder. But the guar gum does impart a nice mouth feel to the drink and to other foods, which is very smooth and more noticeable than that obtained (in my experience) with xanthan. It’s silky. It also might contribute a slight taste, but not objectionably so. Maybe the guar has more carbohydrate in it, I don’t know; but I like it, and as far as I’m concerned it’s a good alternative to any other thickener that doesn’t have to be heated to work. That’s one nice thing about guar and xanthan: you don’t have to heat them as you do with something like corn starch, so that they can be used either hot or cold. All around, this is a good product and reasonably priced. Thank you, BulkSupplements.

These precise and super sharp clippers leave my nails with a perfect edge and the metal slide back catcher keeps all but the largest of nails contained to dump out when I'm done clipping. I had to hide these away from my wife so she doesn't grab them then leave them somewhere. If you're on the edge about paying this much for some clippers, take the plunge, you're going to need clippers for the rest of your life, why not use something that does the job well? If you need a cheaper option, look at Seki Edge SS-106 (or 107 if you prefer larger clippers to do your toenails as well).

These Medium clippers work equally well on my fingernails as well as my toenails and leave a clean edge without a need to file. In the rare case a file is needed, the one included in the handle doesn't trigger the "nails on a chalkboard" problem I have with traditional nail files, I've used it a couple of times to round out an edge that I messed up due to poor technique.

text: I've owned an Aria scale for 9 months.  The positives are it seems accurate enough, syncs well with the fitbit cloud, and uses double A batteries. Negatively, beyond recording your weight in a crude graph, the free web app is useless.The apps other feature is a report e.g. "you gained 0.5 lb" since the last measurement. Since there is no running average or other statistic to show the trend, so you just get a depressing message for a normal fluctuation. The dots on the graph are bigger than a half pound and there is no way to change graph's the scale to gauge your normal variation. The net effect is hardly more useful than recordings in a notebook. Maybe they think their customers are too dumb to handle statistical information but more useful measurements could be easily be provided optionally on the web page. I think if there is another vendor of internet scales, give them a try.  No web interface could be less valuable than Aria's.

title: It works!
text: Somehow, this stuff is a miracle.  I have had horrendous leg cramps for a very long time and have tried everything.  One night, after sitting on the edge of the tub at 2 a.m. massaging hot water on my calves, I decided to hit the computer when the pain finally left.  This was the third time in the same night with such strangling pain that I was crying.  I typed in leg cramp remedies and this came up.  Up to this point, I was drinking diet quinine tonic (as per doctor) and massaging my legs with lavender oil, and stretching before bedtime.  Nothing was completely helping.  This Amish remedy came up and the reviews were all positive so I decided to give it a shot.  First time I used it, they stopped within minutes.  One night, they were so bad, I rubbed it on my calves and the pain stopped.  Last night, after a few consecutive nights of being awakened with cramps and drinking the Amish remedy, I decided to do my own thing.  I took three capfuls in some tomato juice at bedtime.  What could I lose?  Went to bed and slept like a baby!  This stuff seriously works.  I hope I'm not dreaming because I have tried everything and this is the only thing that left me hopeful.  I even have a prescription relaxant that I take and doesn't always work.  Hope I'm onto something here.  It's amazing that you can rub it on the affected area and it works too.  The vinegar is a bit harsh if you swig it from the bottle, which you want to do when you catapult yourself out of bed, but I find it's easier in tomato juice.  Taking it before bed now.  Praying this continues to work.  Give it a try.  I've been telling everyone because those night leg cramps seem to be rampant!

text: I've been using this toothbrush for over a month and love it! The bristles are very soft, even softer than a "soft" version of a Colgate Plastic toothbrush that you can buy for ~$3.50 at any super market. The handle is great, smooth, easy to hold, and lightweight. (not that I worry about the weight of my toothbrush, it is definitely more comfortable than my previous plastic brushes) I've had no problems with a moldy handle, as I ensure my bathroom is well ventilated and the toothbrush doesn't sit in a dirty cup/toothbrush holder. (We put them in a clean drawer or a toothbrush suction holder, that attaches to the mirror) To each is own, but I do not recommend putting the brush back into a used/dirty cup. Whatever it is you use, just ensure it's ventilated and dry. For the reviews that talk about humid climates and moldy brushes, we live in a very humid climate, and I've had no issues yet. I highly recommend trying these brushes, and  $8.99 for 10 brushes is a great deal, even if the lifetime is shorter, you're saving money over the long run!

title: Not fully charged on arrival -- old?
text:
I haven't had these long enough to judge their actual effectiveness, though I have used this type of batteries before and have been happy with them.

However, I wanted to submit this review to indicate that I was surprised that these "pre-charged" batteries didn't have more of a charge when I received them. I am using the first two of them in my wireless trackpad and my system reports the battery level below 65%. Based on the chart on the back of the batteries, it's supposed to take something like three years for the batteries to drain to that level when unused.

I see four possibilities:
1. The batteries are simply that old -- I could find no indication of when they were produced.
2. They were not really fully charged when packaged.
3. Whatever voltage my trackpad reports as 100% is simply higher than these provide -- I doubt this but I suppose I should try recharging the batteries to verify.
4. These are in some way defective -- I've been using this pair for over a week without trouble, so if they are defective, they're not disastrously so.

I am giving four start with the assumption that either #1 or #2 is accurate. I suppose if it is really #1, then I'd judge the seller, but I have no way of distinguishing between #1 and #2.

text:
If you buy this device, make sure you have either a very patient friend nearby or a good pair of scissors. Depending on your individual circumstances, you may also wish to have either the fire department and/or the local burn unit on standby.

It arrived on time without incident. It was a lightning deal, so a good bargain. It's cute, in a "this is a pink girl thing" sort of way. In concept, the features seem good. In practice, not so much.

My problem, which I must suggest is not isolated, was that after heating the device, I carefully rolled some hair around the brush to curl. The device immediately took control of my hair, and refused to allow me to unroll. I might mention that it was hot, and that the curl I was aiming for was more beachy wave than Shirley Temple.

I unplugged the device and begged my husband to remove this obviously cannibalistic monster from my head, preferably without removing my hair or scalp. It took a while, and it was painful.

I will never use it again. I'm debating whether to return it or chalk it up to a bad idea and a warning to others.

In the AM, I got a whole sack of micro fiber rags out, and went to work on the cabinet. First, rags to take off the excess product. Then, a clean, new one, in fine, it was one rag for all 06 sides. This buffs out the finish. When done, you can toss a dime on top and watch it glide off the other side. Now, you can judge from the Photo, how it looks. And note too- this photo is done with a cheap flip phone camera. The reflection you see is from an East facing window-the photo taken a circa Noon.
If you want a wood finish that works, is good for the wood, and good for your hands{no gloves nor HAZMAT suit needed for this product} and smells fabulous - this is the ONLY one to buy- as I have been for several years, and for all my antique furniture.

title: I love the feeling of a knee scooter BUT ... it’s very easy to tip over
text:
After a bad car accident I broke my foot in 17 places and need to be zero weight bearing for 4 months! I have a wheelchair and walker but the knee scooter is absolutely my only sanity. Dare I say it’s even fun at times. BUT ... this isn’t the sturdiest scooter. I’m 62, female, 240 lbs. my main complaint is when turning the handlebars sharply its VERY easy to simply fall over the handlebars and I did. Fortunately I wasn’t hurt.

I got the all terrain wheels because our driveway is gravel and cobblestone and this was a great idea that works well. Otherwise the small wheels would simply sink into the gravel instead of being able to roll over the top. So I was happy with that. Despite my age and size I have a better than average sense of balance which is the only reason I haven’t hurt myself. I would NOT buy this particular scooter given the opportunity to do it again. It’s dangerous. If there’s a way to test ride the scooter before you is your only safe bet. While in physical rehab hospital I used a different scooter and the steering wheel could not turn so sharp that it flips.

Reading the other reviews it’s clear that everyone is not reviewing the same knee scooter. But bottom line, a knee scooter is a terrific way to get around. You feel more able bodied and it does have a fun factor. Just make sure you’ve had plenty of time to adjust to it. Also, my insurance would not cover the knee scooter and it’s surprisinghow few people even know they exist.

title: Couldn’t be more pleased
text:
I take a variety of medicines, and I was a bit embarrassed to always carry around my pill bottles everywhere. I take 6 daily meds, various sizes. These have 7 compartments, 3 larger, 4 smaller. One of my pills is longer and bigger around than a Tylenol 500mg gelcap. One larger compartment holds exactly 8, oriented sideways. All my other pills are much smaller, so I can easily fit 8 or more in the other compartments. I use the 7th for Tylenol. I get to be the hero when I pull some out of my pink pill case for a coworker suffering a headache. I don’t know how many times it’s come in handy, just for that alone.

The container for the pills comes out of the carry case, so it’s easier to clean. The fact that you get two is also a nice bonus. You can still use one while you’re waiting on one to dry after washing.

I love(!) that it latches shut. I don’t have to worry about it coming open in my purse. (Meds are expensive, don’t want to lose any...) That was one reason I didn’t want the regular kind you find at drug stores, since they don’t seem secure.

I don’t notice any kind of odor, other than a faint plastic smell, but that’s everything when it’s new. There’s absolutely nothing flimsy about this. Even the inner pill holder feels tougher than I was expecting. Everything latches with a nice, audible “snap,” but they aren’t hard to open, which is a wonder.

My only “complaint” (if you can even call it that), is that the compartment on the far right is sliiiiightly smaller than the other two larger compartments. I think it’s because the edges are rounded. This would only be a problem if you needed to stuff all three with an exact number of larger pills, though. When I was trying to fit 8 of my largest pills, the lid to the inner compartment wouldn’t close, so I moved them to the middle larger compartment and that solved that.

Over all, these are fantastic for carrying around your pills without rattling every time you move, and I could see how they’d be great for traveling, though I haven’t taken them on a plane yet (I fully intend to!). I cut the amount of space taken up by pills in my purse waaaaay down. No more pill bottles!
