title: This Is My Go-To Peanut Butter! I'll Never Have Anything Other Than This.
text:
I personally loved this peanut butter. I came across this at my local nutrition store. The only downfall is the price but if you're really looking to get all those macros in then you know it's worth the sacrifice. It was more expensive when I bought it at my local nutrition store so luckily I was able to find it here and save a couple of bucks every time I buy it.

Now, of course it's not going to have the same texture or the exact same taste as regular peanut butter. You can't realistically think that it will. It's a high protein, of course it's going to be a little different. I've had a spoonful, I've had it in shakes and I've had it as a spread, and not matter which why I've eaten it, it's really good. Never had an aftertaste or anything like that.

The texture is a little different, it's not as creamy as regular peanut butter, it's a noticeably a tad more grainy...probably something along the lines of wet sand (fyi I've never eaten wet sand, that's just the closest I can come to describing it). It's also a little harder to spread than regular peanut butter, I tore my slice of bread the first time I spread it but you get accustomed to it. One thing I did notice was that I had to mix it before every time I was about to get a serving because the water in it tends to rise to the top. Just a couple of swirls with a spoon or butter knife and you'll be good to go.

If you love peanut butter, love white chocolate and you're looking for a high protein blend to fulfill you're daily macro intake then this is the peanut butter for you. I have never turned back and I doubt that you will once you get a taste of it.

title: Good kit with everything you need for lash perm!
text:
Very happy with this kit. It had everything I needed plus some. Had a lash perm done at a salon and hated the results(one side of lashes laid horizontally flat on my lid). So decided to try & do it myself!
I do wish it had more detailed instructions on placement of pink pads. I didn't place it on my lid properly the 1st time. 2nd one I paid more attention to placement.
I threw away the white sticky rolls. They tore out a couple lashes trying to place them on my lid. Used pink pad instead.

Tips: When using the pink silicone pads put a little extra glue on the ends. And let them dry to the point of being sticky before putting them on lid.
Don't use too much glue for getting the lashes to stick to the pink pad or it won't allow the perming solution to penetrate the lashes.
Take your time separating and combing the lashes on to the pad before putting the solution on. Work on half of the lashes at a time.

I used this heating pad twice in one day. The first time that I used it, it worked great! It took about 3 mins in the microwave to be a comfortable heat. The second time I used it (1 hr later), the clay beads burnt through the casing and started spilling all over.

Having isolated pockets is a good idea. It prevents the beads from falling to the bottom of their contained space,and preventing few beads to fall to the bottom of the confined space. However, in this case the very small pockets along the shoulder tended to overheat before the large pockets heated through, resulting in a molten fabric, and thus, a hole to allow the beads to escape.

Maybe a more versatile fabric like cotton that isn't as heat sensitive would have been a better option. Better yet, a cotton shell with a furry polyester sleeve.

text: Great Nature Classics (from Blue Poppy) is a well respected company in the Chinese Medicine community. I've taken their herbs myself and ordered many of their formulas for my patients. They are cGMP (certified Good Manufacturing Process) so you know what the bottle says is in there is actually what you're getting. Taking this formula post motorcycle accident was my first experience with Chinese Herbs. I had been run over by a car on the freeway after my motorcycle had broken down and I broke my left Tibia and Fibula in 3 places. The swelling and pain was horrendous. It took about 5 days for the formula to kick in, but suddenly I realized I was sleeping better at night and my leg wasn't getting nearly as swollen. I couldn't believe it was the herbs that were helping so much when Vicodin and ibuprofen did so little to help, but eventually I ran out of the herbs and within a couple days the swelling started to slowly return. title: I have been told that Lutein is a good supplement for promoting healthy eyes and slowing down any ...
text:
I purchased this Lutein because I have the beginnings of Macular Degeneration. I have been told that Lutein is a good supplement for promoting healthy eyes and slowing down any damage that may be occurring.. I am trying to do whatever I can to keep my eyes healthy. So when I was offered the opportunity to try the Sigmaceutical brand of Lutein, I wanted to give it a try. This bottle contains 60 capsules, and one daily serving is two capsules - so this bottle contains a one month supply. Each serving contains 20 mg of Lutein, as well as a variety of other vitamins and supplements.

I think it is important that anyone who has food allergies (like many people in my family do), should know is that is product is manufactured and packaged in a facility that also MAY process milk, soy,wheat, egg, peanuts, tree nuts, fish and shellfish. This is important to know before using this product, as it could cause life threatening issues.

I have been using this Lutein, and so far I am very happy with it. This is something that needs to be used long-term to realize any results that can be noticed, but the list of ingredients is very impressive, and comparable to other brands I have used. I would recommend this product to anyone who wants to actively promote keeping their eyes healthy, and who do not have any of the above mentioned food allergies.

title: What I like about this alarm is the fact it makes sound
text:
UPDATE AFTER TWO MONTHS OF USE:
This alarm causes us many problems, including false alarms, a clip that doesn't always stay on the underwear, a clip that we have to fight with nightly to get it to stay attached to the housing for the clip. Right now my husband is diligently taking it apart to figure out why there is a short causing the alarm to sound continuously. I wish I had splurged on the malem. When this alarm works I like it, but it seems like it is working less and less the longer we use it. Spending extra on a better alarm is worth it.
ORIGINAL REVIEW:
We have had the alarm for 2 weeks. We have had several issues with false alarms due to sweating and the clip coming detached from the underwear. We found a solution, which is why I'm still giving this 4 stars. We have found that the clip stays in place if our daughter wears 2 layers of underwear with it clipped to the innermost one. There is less pulling on it that way. Not much we can do about sweating. Our bedrooms tend to be very hot in the summer. What I like about this alarm is the fact it makes sound, vibrates, and has a flashing light all at the same time. You cannot change the tone, but our daughter has not gotten used to it. I'm not sure it would work very well for our very deep sleeping son. The sound isn't overly loud, but high pitched enough to get your attention. You can hear it well enough that it wakes me in the next room. It doesn't wake the rest of the family, so in my book that's a plus. We are finally starting to see some progress with a dry night here and there, so overall I am happy with this alarm.

title: Efficient, Effective, Excellent. Buy!
text:
I wanted to wait a while (6 weeks) before posting a review on this product to make sure I utilized it enough. For reference, I was a BlenderBottle+ProStak user for a number of years. I ran into the same issues others did with the screw-on top either eventually leaking or cracking. I was mostly interested in the ProStak capabilities of the bottle rather than the bottle itself. I tend to mix supplements/powders throughout the day so being able to carry them around in ProStak containers was helpful especially because they screwed on to the bottom of my 16oz (22oz when filled to the top) bottle. That was also a complaint I had! The ProStak capable bottles are way too small for my liking (i.e. not enough ounces).

Enter Hydra Cup!

Pros:
- 36oz capacity
- 2 separate compartments (22oz + 14oz) that don't leak/mix allowing for different supplements being pre-mixed
- No noisy BlenderBottle shaker ball

Cons:
- My investment in ProStak containers! My Hydra Cup bottom seems to be the same dimensions as the ProStak tops... if my Hydra Cup only had the slots I could twist my ProStak containers onto! :)

Concerns:
- This is a concern not a con (and hopefully won't be), the 4 clips that clamp the lid onto the bottle are plastic and lacking a true hinge or something to pivot on. You can see the plastic changing color where it bends to clamp onto the bottle. If there was a slightly different design that allowed for a small steel rod (or equivalent) there would be no strain on the plastic and possible point of failure. Like I said, this isn't a problem but I could see it being an issue especially if someone is mixing multiple times a day as I am. We'll see.

All in all, the best mixing bottle I've ever used and at an amazing price! I don't have any real complaints and I hopefully won't. Looking forward to what innovation comes next from Hydra Cup! Great product and recommended buy!

title: Superb Dermascope!
text:
I'm a senior dermatology resident, I have used before the DermLite DL100, DermLite II Pro and Hybrid M.
I currently own a DL3 and DL3N.

Obviously the light, lens quality image and view size against DermLite DL 100 is indescribably better on the DL3. While the DermLite II Pro and Hybrid gives an almost perfect illumination and image quality in my point of view the DL3 (normal and N) gave an even better resolution and light over the other two. If have to put them on a light/image quality rank that would be:
1) DL3, 2) II Pro 3) Hybrid M.

If you want to do both contact-Non-polarized-light-dermoscopy and non-contact polarized light dermoscopy there is no room for hesitation and the DL3 is your best option (the difference with light and quality of the Hybrid is significant so you would be wasting money instead of saving a $300)
However if do not intend to do both types of dermoscopy I rather recomend the Dermlite II-Pro because of its brighter led's.

And finally, I needed 2 dermoscopes so I took a risk to buy both the DL3 and DL3N, however until now I guess I just trow out $200 with the DL3N as the pigment boost have no really use (at least not found by me or any of my colleges or attendance professors), also there's not evidence published in pubmed or embase to support its use.

Ps. I do not think that anyone without a proper training in dermoscopy will found and adequate use of this examination tool, so if you are not a dermatologist maybe any other would fit best for you (DL II or even the cheapest ones like the carbon or dl-100)

I was diagnosed with Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia when I was discharged for 20 years in the navy. I remember when the doctor told me that I was devastated. I wasn't even really sure what it was or how bad it was. I started studying very hard to see if there was a solution (this was in 2012). One day it hit me. My sister had given me this book but I blew it off. Then, I took things into my own hands and did exactly as the diet suggested.

The first 3 weeks were, one week nothing but water and carrot juice. Next week the same but with apple juice. Oh and herbs that cleanse and strengthen the body. The third week with grape juice. Week 4 would be back to carrot juice. Week 5 apple. Week 6 grape. But, at the beggining of week 4 you can start introducing fruits, vegetables, grains. I even started eating fish once a week.

I continued doing that for about three months. I was already in decent shape. I had been training for a marathon, however while doing the diet I stopped running. The funny thing is even though I stopped running I could easily go out and run ten miles and not be sore the next day. This is when I was in my early 50's.

After 3 months I went back to the doctor and did some blood tests the week before. He came into the room and I was crossing my fingers that my white blood cell count was down. He came in and said, "we're not sure what you have. Your white blood count is almost back to normal." I just about fell out of my chair. I did several more check ups and my health was great. I found out something I never knew. All my life I couldn't breathe very well in spite of being in sports. It used to take me a few miles of jogging slow before my airways would open up and then I could take off and run. After a few months my lungs cleared up and I didn't need to warm up. I could just take off. I've often wondered since then that maybe I had light asthma. But now it was gone.

Well, it's been about eight years. I got lax and only did the diet about 2 years. In those times I never felt better or happier. I don't know the terms too well but the chemical that gets released in the brain that makes you feel happy, I felt that beautiful feeling everyday.

I would gladly suggest this program to anyone especially if you are up against a tough problem. I'd say if you were diagnosed with some kind of cancer that if you did this program it would help tremendously to help your bodies ability to fight it. I won't say it cures cancer because I know that's a drastic statement to make in the medical and health world.

I think if you try it you will see miracles. One caution is I see a lot of reviews where people say they tried variations or portions of the diet. Please go all in with this diet and you will see miracles and you will be happy to see your health get tremendously better.
Best of luck.

One more word. I see the 'top critical review' saying it was an overpriced advertisement.' Comments like that make you feel they were paid to say that. It works.

title: Sunbeam Should be Ashamed of This Scale
text: When this scale arrived I carefully followed the very simple instructions as printed on the back of the box to zero out the scale. Placing the scale on a concrete surface, the first problem encountered was the dial would not stay at zero when the adjustment dial was released. Second problem was any slight movement, even a small nudge, of the scale made the dial jump to anywhere between 10 and 30 pounds indicated, which required another cumbersome reset to zero. Third problem was once zeroed and left stationary, the scale did not accurately weigh three different people. It was off by a factor of over 100 pounds for each person! And once again between someone standing on the scale, it would not return to zero and had to be readjusted. And again, the scale did not want to stay exactly on the zero. We tried several different times in several different ways to get the scale to work properly, and it never would accurately display weight or return to zero after each and every use. The scale is one of the worst purchases I've ever made, but due to the cheap price it's not even worth sending back. Sunbeam should be ashamed to put their name on such a junk piece of equipment. Best advice I can give is leave it on Amazon and look for something better if you're looking for dial type scale.

title: Wait for it...
text:
Someone gave me this protien powder because they didnt like the texture/taste of it. I actually really like it and it seems like a good, no fuss product. 6 ingredients with one being a plant based protien blend that does not contain pea protien. For whatever reason, pea protien hurts my stomache and most non-dairy powders have that. So far so good. But here is where things take a turn - I went to their website to purchase it and they show two different pictures of the container, one with significantly more weight and serving size but the same amount of servings. However there is no option for big or small, they just sell it 'by the jar' when you want to buy. Not a big deal, I assume its the smaller one, but I generally like to know exactly what Im getting and it almost seems like false advertising. Then the big red flag is after I entered my payment info, the next page is an upsale page - 'wait!
Before you complete your order, just this once, we want you to have the benefits of three jars for 65% savings, you wont see this offer ever again for as long as you live, dont waste this amazing opportunity!' - blah blah, no thanks. Next page, same thing. Ok. And the next page. And the next page. And the next page.. On and on until Ive made my way through the entire product catalog. Dont get me wrong, I understand the psychology of upsaling and it has its place, but at a certain point it becomes clear that a company's intention is to cram as much product down your throat and turn you into one of their 'high-five' sales. This went there and then some. Thats a pretty off-putting way of doing business and its downright dirty. If that doesnt bother you though and you like the product, this could be the right protien for you. And if you take them up on all those deals you could turn around and sell it here for a decent profit actually (currently selling at $63 here which is $23 more than the average cost buying in bulk from Gundry). I was already locked into my one 'jar' purchase, but I wouldnt buy this product again just based on their dirty sales tactics.

title: Without pain
text:
I just recently started training with a personal fitness coach. I have been to 2 sessions so not too far into it. In the first session she tried to get me to do lunges and I couldn't. I had a hard time bending as far as I needed to go because my knees just want to give out. So she told me that I need to get glucosamine. I have never even heard of it. I researched it and found that Nutripure was a good brand to purchase. I bit the bullet and decided to give it a try. I have had these supplements for about 5 days and I have taken them according to the recommended dosages and already I can feel a major difference in the way my knees feel. I was firstly impressed that Nutripure was a combination of three of the best joint health ingredients to help keep your joints in good health (according to my fitness coach) - Chondroitin Sulfate, Glucosamine Sulfate, MSM (Methylsulfonylmethane)
Glucosamine helps your body repair damaged or eroded cartilage. When I was in middle school, I had a freak of nature growth, 7 inches in one summer and it ate away the cartilage in my knees. Glucosamine stimulates production of new cartilage, so that seemed logical for this brand to put into a joint support vitamin.
Chondroitin attracts fluid and lubrication to cartilage, to act as shock absorbers and deliver nutrients into cartilage. So if you know anything about cars, chondroitin is basically like getting your oil changed regularly but for bones instead of your engine.
With Glucosamine and Chondroitin acting as a happy marriage in repairing your joints, cartilage and tendons, MSM ramps up your body's own ability to produce antioxidants. So it would be like drinking a ton of orange juice, cranberry juice, and eating a ton of greens all the time.
Each bottle contains about 80 days worth of product, which I am sure is if you are using it correctly, so there is quite a bit in it for the price you're paying. Plus this brand is 100% guarantee or your money back. Really there is no risk in just trying it.
I received this product at a discounted rate for my honest and unbiased review.

title: No soy!
text:
I have been regularly lifting weights for going on nine or so months now. While I have been able to eat enough protein to help fuel me during my workouts, I still have not been ingesting the amount that I would like. I use to drink protein shakes regularly, but have not been able to as of late due to finding out that I was allergic to a lot of the ingredients in those protein shakes...the biggest culprit being soy. The problem for me is that I had to either choose from ingesting something that I was allergic to, paying an arm and a leg for the same basic product without the extra allergens put in, or just discontinuing use altogether. So I chose the latter and tried to replace it with high protein foods, which was not always an easy thing to do. Then I came across this and purchased it to give it a try.

As indicated above, this whey protein powder does not contain a single ounce of soy lecithin, soybean oil, or any other soy derivative. It comes packed with 20 grams of protein and only 3 grams of sugar per each serving. The container has a total of 22 servings, which should be able to last you a little under a month if you only take it once a day. The price is more expensive than I would have liked for only 583 total grams of powder, but compared to some of the other soy-free protein shakes out there...I really cannot complain too much. The powder mixes quite evenly and the banana flavor is actually pretty tasty. You still get that protein taste that is in all of them, but the banana seems to mask it pretty decently.

Note: I purchased this product at a discount in exchange for an honest review, and this IS my honest and unbiased thoughts on this product.

title: You get what you pay for
text:
My wife begged me for weeks to find her a bubble bath mat to place in our soaker tub. I reviewed home spa options like the Homedics Body Bubbles Bath Spa for a several hours before finally deciding, based on all the reviews that I had read, there really weren't any great options. You can spend a couple hundred dollars for a bubble bath product, and still get product with many poor reviews. This model was one of the cheaper ones available. In my mind, if none of the options are great, you might as well get one on the cheap end. The good news is that my wife is happy that her soaker tub can now have some bubbles.

The main shortfall of this product shows itself immediately. The suction cups do not hold the mat to the floor of the tub, so it simply floats up to the surface. My wife doesn't seem to mind all that much. As long as you're laying on the mat, your body holds it down. But move your legs or shift your weight, and this mat quickly floats away. Otherwise, the product is OK. It's not loud in our opinion; a real jacuzzi is louder than this. It's not too big and bulky.

I wouldn't recommend this product without making sure that people know about it's has an inconvenient drawback. If you can live with that, then the price for this unit is right. Had I purchased a more expensive unit and found the same problem, I would have been bitterly disappointed.

title: Critically Flawed
text:
These earplugs fit my medium-sized ears snugly but were excruciatingly difficult to remove. The stem portion of the earplug is too short to grip firmly, and in struggling to remove the plug, half of the time I'd accidentally separate the stem from the tip. The first time this happened, the stem went flying and I had a difficult time finding it. Why the two pieces are so easily separated is beyond me, especially considering that the stem is designed to be grasped when removing the earplug. This is a serious design flaw.

After only two days of owning the earplugs, while at a music festival and desperately trying to remove one of the earplugs from my ear, the whole thing popped out, flew away, and was instantly lost in the crowd of people around me. Note that these things are small, clear, and impossible to spot on asphalt in the dark. I'm now the not-so-proud owner of one earplug.

I do have to say that the sound quality while wearing the earplugs during the short time that I had the pair was very good. However, I was still left with some ringing, which led me to question whether the most harmful frequencies were actually being attenuated. I'm certain I had a proper fit, and the music I was listening to was far from being the loudest music I might subject myself to. The quality of the sound getting through doesn't matter much if it's still harmful to your hearing.

Overall my experience was a huge disappointment, and I'd warn everyone that this product is critically flawed to the point of irresponsibility on the part of the manufacturer. Don't let them take your money until they fix the product.

title: Frustratingly poor quality. Waste of Money
text: This thing is a nightmare right out of the box, The instructions are atrocious. They could not have put less energy into the instructions. There is a sleeve that should be included to join the steering tube with the tube connecting the handlebars, mine came without it. That aside, I used a clamp I have, which is probably higher quality than the missing part (after much searching online it looks like a simple plastic sleeve coupling), then assembled and tested what I could. The bracket that secures the steering tube once you fold it up is more cheap plastic, so once you get that put together the handlebars have about two inches of sway in them. The entire front-end rocks all over the place. I'm going to have to buy a decent clamp for $.75 since they chose not to use one, and just secure the front end myself. The tightening wheel for the seat height adjustment bumps directly into another bolt so tightening the seat is a pain and will lead to bruised knuckles. There is no online resource or phone number to call for help, just an email. The clip that holds the bag on the front has two little connecting points that slide into slots. They're uneven and crooked. I got the bag on after some fussing, but it just shows the poor workmanship. I'm having surgery very soon; I cannot send this thing back. I'm very mechanically inclined so I'm going to secure this thing on my own with various clamps and metal screws. It's sharp looking, and the seat is quite comfortable, so to be fair, it gets high marks there.  I reached out to the company that sells this thing.  I'll edit this when and if the seller gets back to me with a resolution.

title: Future long time customer
text:
I have used many different pre-workouts over the last several years, and have had a variety of different experiences. Due to my work schedule, I have to rotate between early morning workouts and late evening workouts, and if you try to take supplements to maximize the benefits of weightlifting, it can be discouraging to do so when things like staying awake or falling asleep are important to you. That being said, I wanted to try this product for about a month to get an accurate depiction of what it does for me.
My initial reactions:
I work in the chemicals industry and fully appreciated the fact that no coloring is added to this mix. It mixes clear and tastes excellent (Watermelon). It does not have the typical artificial sugar aftertaste that is really common in pre-workout supplements. I knew that it was a higher than average stimulant product, so the first time I tried it, was during my early morning workout.
It hits hard and fast, but in a very good way. I was able to take it as I pulled into the parking lot, and felt the effects quickly. I definitely felt that I was able to get more out of my workout, more weight, more reps, before I felt my muscles fatigue. I don't know if it was a placebo effect, however I will note that I did experience this same thing every time I used the product. One the days I forgot to bring it with me, I felt a markedly different way during the workout (I keeps some other powders in my truck just in case) and did not feel the same surge during those workouts.
There is no crash when the product wears off. This was huge for me. I was able to go throughout a 12 hour shift, without feeling wiped out, needing an additional pick me up.
When working out at night, I was worried about the potential difficulties falling asleep, however I was pleasantly surprised to find myself falling asleep with no difficulties.
I would normally take about 4g of Beta Alanine, along with some vasodilators, but found this made it so I didn't have to take any additional pre workout supplements except for my creatine.
I can see myself using this product for a good long time, not only for my workouts, but occasionally when I need to use a little bit of a boost during a busy day.

text: I must say, this has been THE BEST heath care purchase I have ever made.  This product does exactly what it says it will do, only better. They didn't break open or nothing like that but they were sore.  My wife, each night, put on the foot treatment and nothing ever helped.  She was so worried about my feet as they were so dry, more so in the winter, that she told me that I had some yellow spots on my feet!  Well, the dry dead skin was so thick, it was, frankly gross. I'm now down to 4 times a week, for a few seconds, just for maintenance of my feet and the results have been nothing short of fantastic.  My feet are pink, soft and just like when I was 25.  I honestly can't believe it.  This is a great product and I can't recommend it enough.  I have found that the little rollers last longer than you think and I purchased four more of the Emjoi rollers.  Not the after market ones.  As a matter of fact, I'm going to buy a second unit for back up and some gift ones.  My parents are older and they would love this.  My honest opinion is that if you get this product, you will be happy you did.  If you saw my feet before and after, you would be amazed.

title: Should have done this years ago! Part I
text: This is a great product. It performed better than I expected. The only thing I was not pleased with is that the cord kept coming out of the plug. You can push it all the way in really hard, but it still finds it way of coming out. So don't be moving the cord around so much or else you'll be stopping all of the time just to put the plug back in. But other than that, it worked exceptionally well. The packaged arrived on the date of the expected delivery. I had an appointment that morning and when I returned at 12 noon, the package was left at my door on the stoop. That, I didn't like because anyone could have walked by and taken it. As soon as I opened it, I started using it. It took me 4 hours to do bother feet. I'm assuming 2 hours on each foot. My feet were baby soft and smooth. There's no way to contain all the dust on some newspaper like someone else had said. A big damp towel worked better for me. Of course, you're gonna have to sweep up afterwards. And, you're gonna have to get in the shower, as well. The product came with 2 blue rollers, but I had also ordered the green rollers. At first, I started using the blue rollers, but after a while I switched over to using the green rollers. The green rollers are better. They are more coarser than the blue ones and they work much deeper on the hard skin. Another thing, don't stay too long on one area of the foot, you don't want to make the area tender. Move the roller around as you go back and forth on the foot; but, add a little pressure as you roll it along. The more pressure you add, the deeper the roller will lift up the dead skin. Also, it's a good idea to knock some of that dust off of the roller as it can clog it up and it may slow up on you, which is what it did with me a couple of times. The product came with a little brush to clean the dust off, but I just rinsed mine off with some water on the non-electrical end, dried it off; and, then let it sit out to air dry for a few hours. Two other things I wanted to mention that was not described in the product description, is that, I was able to file down flat the thick toenails on each foot of my big toe. And an added bonus is that after you finish, your feet are gonna feel wonderful. Your feet will feel like you just had a foot massage. It's because of the vibration of the motor on your foot. You will feel a very tingling and warm sensation on the soles of your feet once you get up and start to walk.

text:
I had embarrassingly dry callus feet. This stems from years of working retail and this horrible. ugly, dry winter we had recently. I saw this product (the battery operated version) on a recent issue of Marie Claire as a must have from an international editor. After doing my research, I decided to go with the plug in version since reviews state it works much better.

Although I partake of reviews enthusiastically, some might even say religiously, this ancient holy book actually is a product outside of that mindset, and that is how I, a complete nobody, come to be the first to 'review' it on Amazon, even though there are thousands and thousands in use.

Well, fools rush in. Most sensible people would as soon review the Almighty. What criteria might possibly apply? Did it 'last' long? Oh yes. Did it meet one's expectations? Is it complete? Most certainly! All of the sung parts of the year's grand rotation of the traditional Catholic liturgy is here, from Advent to the Passion, and with the apurtinent rubrics, when to bow, when to genuflect, when to offer incense. Everything, every dominus vobiscum and introit and prayer. And you will find the Liber Usualis, rarely new as offered here, but neatly stacked by the organ, or sometimes scattered in the pews, scuffed and worn by the sweaty, sooty, weary hands of men singing in scholas, raising their voices in choir lofts both humble and high, in the Congo, in Chicago, Guadalajara, Madrid, Manilla, and someday on the Moon and then even beyond, each worn copy with its asperges of the appropriate vernacular, otherwise in the solemn, dead language in which we reposit our Faith and put to haunting music rendered in those little square notes from the olden times. The Liber Usualis is a book of music for only one Listener. He must think it five star, the way it lasts, even through that disasterous conflagration called Vatican II.

text: after years of suffering painful cracks in the ends of my fingers (thumbs in particular) during the winter from the drying effects of the furnace heat, i decided to try the old vaseline and gloves routine, so i looked at every moisturizing glove option amazon offered and decided on the madholly gloves (i liked the price and knew i would want a lot of them so i could rotate to a clean pair every few nights) -- it took a couple of nights to get used to the sensation of having something on my hands (i think this is why i prolonged trying this method) but now i don't even know i have them on --  i find them very comfortable, and my fingers aren't that long so the bunched fabric at the end of the glove's fingers doesn't bother me like some reviewers complained about -- and yes, they are cheaply made (what do you expect at this price?!) but i wash them by putting several pairs in a lingerie bag, wash the bag(s) by itself in the washing machine using the mini water level and hot water to get the greasiness out, then i line dry them on my clothes rack, and they hold up and keep their shape really well this way -- all in all, i'm VERY satisfied with this product and my hands thank me every day for using these gloves!

text:
I frequently buy from Amazon so I know people prefer to have reviews to the point and the long reviews just get skimmed so I'm going to keep it concise:

Pros:
It contains liquids without leaking. Hence, it is a bottle.

Cons:
As soon as I opened the box and held the bottle securely in my hands, I knew this was going to be a bad purchase. However, the majority of the reviews online were positive so I began cleaning the bottle. First, I removed the lid. Instantly, I notice that the plastic cap still had plastic that wasn't shaved off. As a man who has been in the construction industry for five years, this represented poor craftsmanship and lack of professionalism. I removed some of the excess plastic and continued cleaning the rest of the bottle. Afterwards, I loaded it up with some protein shake and milk. Held the bottle by the rubber grip with my left hand and tightened the lid with my right. Of course, the rubber grip detached from the plastic bottle and now remains loose. :(

OVERALL: The bottle has a cool look and design but unfortunately, the material and attention to detail is poor. I am not expecting top shelf quality here since it is only $11.99 but a product that is well finished and that works would be appreciated.

P.S. What really sucks is that Amazon no longer allows you to return items for free. As an Amazon Prime member who pays $100/yr, if a product is poor quality or I want to exchange it for another item on Amazon, I should be able to return that item without additional charges. So because Amazon wants to charge me $5.99 to return this bottle, I am now stuck with this bottle. Why? Because it will cost me the $5 I would get back as a refund just to drive to the nearest UPS and back. This bottle and I are going to be in an emotionally abusive relationship. [ I am going to hate it and yet have to continue to use it just to mix my protein not out of love.] I'll toss this terrible product in the dumpster soon enough!

text: The QLE floss worked great for me. I have some tight interdental spaces in my teeth as well.  I believe in sustainability, and I know good products when I use it. I like the mint flavoring - it wasn't too strong, had a nice scent to it and left my mouth feeling clean.  I don't actually like to floss often due to soreness afterwards but this QLE floss didn't leave my gums feeling swollen.  I really like the idea behind the plant-based packaging.  For those who don't know (or read reviews), regular floss is made of plastic and literally takes hundreds of years to break down.  After using this floss I loved how my gums feel, and love what this company is doing to make an impact.

title: Happy with my Vogmask
text:
Fit:
I purchased a couple of these for me and for my family for the pandemic. I ordered myself a medium+ and all other adults got a large. I am taller than the recommended height on their sizing chart but have an exceptionally small face, and the medium+ fits well. I also ordered their neck strap for myself (due to my small head circumference earloops just don't cut it for me) and for my Aunt who dislikes the feeling of earloops all day. The neck strap is $8 and REALLY helps with all-day comfort and sealed fit.

Price:
$44 is a bit steep for a mask, I was hoping that the regular (pretty-patterned) microfiber masks would be offered for $33, but that seems unlikely since this company is barely stocked for the demand. Like another reviewer said, they're a small company who is just getting slammed by the pandemic so cut them some slack.

Quality:
Even though it was more than I wanted to spend on a mask, you can tell its high quality. The exhale valves make it comfortable for long wear, the material is thick but not too difficult to inhale. The nose bridge is form fitted and comfortable. If I take a big breath in the fabric visibly recedes which would indicate that there are no/minimal leaks. But I can still smell things with it on - for example if someone sprays perfume I can smell it through the mask which would indicate that the perfume particles are penetrating either the mask fabric or (more likely) the seal around my nose and ears - so there must be a little bit of leakage. Overall though I feel protected with the vogmask on - look up their stats on their website, it's a high quality filter.

Caution:
The exhale valves have no filter - this is purely self-protective, it doesn't protect other people from you if you're a carrier. They are supposed to offer non-valved masks at some point as well - not sure when.

title: Defective and should be recalled!
text: I bought this product to help keep my dad from taking a fall because he could not reach the nurse call button all the time.  Great idea, nice pushbutton device, but none of that matters.  I plugged the unit into the nurse call station (it was a Cornell) and it triggered the alarm, but the alarm would not reset.  I have an electrical background so I did some troubleshooting.  I finally came to the conclusion that the output relay used to trigger the alarm has significant leakage current when the contacts are open.  This leakage current is high enough to maintain the alarmed state, so the reset doesn't work.  I did get it working, by installing an interposing relay with no leakage current, then it works properly.  How many people can do that? I think this leakage current issue is a flaw that should get this product recalled, because if it doesn't reset you'll disconnect it, and lose any safety benefit.

Be aware, for example, that even those that say Isolates, may use an inferior process (Isopure for example, uses Ion Exchange). I think Syntrax is the best on the market. title: Average
text:
I purchased this product because I was looking for something to help me concentrate and focus. Not so much for gaming, but for trying to get work done and be productive in general. For starters, when you open the powder it has a very artificial smell to it. It does kind of smell like green apple but it is very fake smelling. As for the taste? Just not good at all. Maybe I should have tried another flavor but this one is just hard to take. It is very artificial tasting, very sweet and leaves an odd aftertaste in your mouth.

Now when it comes to overall effectiveness of the product, for me it was just eh. I was able to accomplish what I had wanted to get done (Some work as well as things around the house- dishes, laundry, vacuuming, etc.) but was by no means blown out of the water by this product’s effectiveness. Yes I was able to concentrate, focus and critically think, but I am not sure whether that was from the product itself or if it was more of a placebo effect. To be honest I was expecting more. Yes I had energy, was able to process clear thoughts and was able to multitask but for me it was about the same as drinking two cups of coffee.

Overall- yes the product worked but it wasn’t a game-changer in my book. I was a slightly more focused, a little faster with reaction times and was able to think a little more clearly. But the difference this product makes is far from drastic. The changes it had on my brain were between minimal and average. The slightly underwhelming results, coupled with the dislike for the taste mean that this is not something I plan to purchase again, unless some improvements are made. The results were not significant enough for me to purchase this product again.

text: Dermal Dye is a must-have product for persons affected by skin tone irregularities caused by such conditions as Vitiligo. What makes this product particularly effective is that the formula permits color customization, by allowing the user to match skin tones through the addition of simple food coloring. The product comes in a clear formula, and I just add the necessary combination of colors to achieve the desired hue. Additionally, one of the active ingredients is thought to actually promote re-pigmentation during the coverup process. A tip for mixing the product with food coloring is to mix in small quantities, say not more than one ounce of Dermal Dye at a time. I use a second small container, and then add the colors as necessary. I have found that I can use a one-ounce mix on both hands for about 4-5 weeks. title: Absolutely Delicious, But There is No Such Thing as a Free Lunch
text:
I find these to be the most delicious of all the Paleo Protein Bars. I have been Paleo for 8 years, and have not had much processed food or treats besides dark chocolate. Perhaps those who hated these are still eating other processed foods, because the first time I ate these after years of no treats or sugar, I absolutely thought I was in heaven! Perhaps they would taste gross to someone whose taste buds are used to regular chocolate and candies, but I found them to be absolutely delightful.

I love these so much, but I actually found that in the long run, they cause weight gain, so I no longer buy them. All sweeteners cause an insulin response, including stevia. Insulin is something absolutely undesirable in every way, especially when it comes to pursuing weight loss, since it can cause increased hunger and cravings. I cannot post links, but here are the titles to a couple of studies discussing the insulin response caused by stevia (google these and you should find them):

"Effects of stevia, aspartame, and sucrose on food intake, satiety, and postprandial glucose and insulin levels"
"Rebaudioside A potently stimulates insulin secretion from isolated mouse islets: Studies on the dose-, glucose-, and calcium-dependency"

text: I love the look of this scale, but it's accuracy is way off. The box that this scale was packaged in was a little scuffed up, but nothing too damaging. When I first stepped on the scale it read my weight but the C popped up meaning the measurement was off and it needed to re-calibrate, which is to be expected the first time you step on it. So after it re-calibrated I stepped on it again and it and my weight reading seemed to be more accurate. I wanted to test out the accuracy so I stepped on the scale for the third time and my reading was different. Then I stepped on it a 4th time and it was different again. I probably stepped on the scale about 10 more times and received 5 different readings within a 10 minute span. The range of weight difference was over a pound. title: An Excellent Improvement Over Clippers
text:
I've been shaving my head for almost 11 years now, starting out using an earlier model of the Headblade, which ruthlessly nicked my poor noggin. I switched to bimonthly shaving using a Wahl 8110 Balding Clipper, which has worked fairly well over the course of about 8 years. This Christmas, my brother gifted me with the Skull Shaver Bald Eagle Smart. I immediately liked the handy LCD charge meter, although its use of a proprietary charging plug instead of a modern standard charging interface (mini or micro USB) which would have been better.

A day after shaving with my Wahl, I applied the Bald Eagle in a front to back pattern on the front half of my head, and a back to front pattern on the back half. The results were impressive, quite smooth in many places, and a fine, almost invisible stubble in all others, a notable improvement over the Wahl. Successive passes resulted in increasing areas of smoothness almost equal to a blade, but much friendlier to my somewhat uneven pate.

All in all I would recommend this product to every makeup lover!

title: If You Need What I Needed, Buy Tangy
text:
I heard of Tangy from a friend, and I was interested because I thought it could help me simply function better. I felt like I needed more sleep all the time, I had no energy or motivation, and minor headaches seemed to be a bit too common.

That being said, in my experience, Tangy Tangerine absolutely works for these reasons. After a few weeks of drinking Tangy, I could get out of bed easily, and I regained energy and motivation. I did simply function better.

If you need what I needed, then buy Tangy. It works.

For those who are looking to Tangy for help with weight loss and dieting however, I'm not sure I can say it helps with appetite. I would say for you guys - save your money and just learn the fundamentals of dieting and/or exercising. After all, there is no shortcut or magic product (yet).

title: Worth getting addicted to...especially if you like really Dark Chocolate
text:
I saw the words "Dark Chocolate" and I lit up. For years now we have been enjoying the lower sugar and positive effects of dark chocolate, braving all the way up to a smooth and cool 90% cocoa -- That's right up there with baking chocolate. I didn't let myself expect much from a commercially made probiotic, and maybe that has to do with my happy surprise. But let me start with the fact that the chocolate is 64% cocoa! Not bad, not bad at all for dark chocolate lovers.

They are the size of a rounded quarter and have a firmness that allows them to be savored - they melt just like a piece of chocolate would. If you are a dark chocolate lover you will appreciate the slight tang and less syrupy sweetness that accompanies milk chocolate. These are really pleasing and they tout that their flora survives our stomach acid 100X better! It took me 4 days, to notice the shift. My roommate took 10 but we both commented on the absence of feeling bloated after dinner and the regularity that ensued (Okay I have to confess that I would often take one at lunch AND dinner)!

These are NOT laxatives but candy bites that are packed with Probiotics or "good bacteria" the stomach needs to help digest our food and maintain a healthy balance of energy and fuel. So rather than feeling that your food takes hours to digest there is really a sense that things are more efficiently being broken down in the intestines. It's not an uncomfortable feeling at all (but could be if you over do them).

They don't taste like they smell, so don't dig your nose in and take a big whiff anticipating a nice rich chocolate smell...You won't. What matters is the flavor and the results both of which you will get.

title: Great Deal for Travel
text:
The greatest value from this 2-in-1 sonic oral device is the water flosser. The waterpik is fairly efficient at cleaning between the gums. It is an added asset to have an attachable toothbrush head for travel but its performance is not as impressive as that of the water flosser. The overall performance is good enough as to exclude an additional sonic toothbrush for short time travel.

A glass or cup from a hotel room can be filled with the tap water which is needed for the fluid stream through the thin suction cable. I found that a small children's cup of roughly 4-ounce liquid capacity is sufficient for throughly flossing the entire mouth. It is possible that a small paper or styrofoam cup may also be employed without it tipping over.

I had some problems a few times in which there was no jet water stream from the pick. This was easily remediated by placing the thin suction tubing in the water cup, turning the center power button on, and sucking out the air until there is a flow of water.

It is definitely a good asset if you don't mind the addition of the suction tube and the cup for its operation. Another plus is that it eliminates clutter because it is USB cable charged. Not a bad way to keep in your pocket ten--10 to thirty--30 dollars by holding back from the more popular brands such as Phillips and Sonicare.

title: The BEST Philips OneBlade case hands down.
text: I got my Philips OneBlade over a year ago (the cheapest version) and have been looking for a case for a while. I recently upgraded my OneBlade to the faster charging model (bought the newer model) and after that I really began to hunt for a case. I live in Iceland and this shaver is not sold here (except for Costco) so there is no place to go for accessories for this shaver. I looked on Amazon, eBay, AliExpress and Googled until the latest hours of the night. But even though I found cases.... No one would ship to Iceland. After all this window shopping I came across this case and really fell in love with its looks and features. I kept an eye on it for the longest time and then finally it was available to ship to Iceland! I made a small order of a few items and as soon as the items arrived I went directly to this case to open, look at and test out. Everything fits so nicely that it just makes you wonder why Philips did not make this an option to purchase as a package deal. The foam insert is absolutely perfectly fitted to every item that came with the OneBlade, I put 4 different size trimming heads plus the snap on protective head cover and there is still one available slot for an addition. Inside on the opposite side there is a zipped mesh pouch that can hold your charger and extra items. The case feels very solid and even the internal rim bracing (just inside of the zipper) is super sturdy and looks like it might even be partially water tight/resistant. The dual zippers have a nice secure feeling with rubberized tabs to pull the zippers, really nice touch. There is also a carbine clip to attach the case to your tent/inside a suitcase/backpack/belt loop, etc. Then finally there is a wrist sling that is removable. Overall this is about as happy as a person could be to get a shaver case :)  But seriously, this is a sturdy, well thought out case that everyone should consider who is looking for a case for their Philips OneBlade. Keep up the good work! I am one very happy customer.

title: Good for outdoors
text: I live in AZ and here we have pack rats (native), field mice, roof rats etc. I place the pouches in areas of my yard where mice will travel-along walls/fences etc.  I also have 3 dogs that I must be mindful of so I needed something safe for them as well.  The rats we have here love citrus and so I spray and place the pouches around those areas.  We saw the first rat last night in an area where I didn't spray and it stopped short of entering my pool area where I have pouches.  Since it is hot here, I spray the pouches 1-2 times per week to replenish them.  This product is a great natural way to repel the mice/rats you may have if they are outdoors. It will not harm your pets or other wildlife the way poison can. If your other neighbors use poison, the rats eat the poison and go someplace else to die (could be your yard).  If you spray this around, it may deter them from doing that so your pets don't ingest a poisoned rat.  I can't speak for it's performance indoors, but it is working for us outdoors.

title: Works perfectly, simpler setup
text:
I purchased the Aria about 6 weeks ago. As others have mentioned, it is a beautiful unit. I have found it easy to use and motivating.

There are lots of excellent reviews on here already. I just wanted to add that I believe Fitbit has simplified setup since the 2012 debut. I found it very simple to setup. I put it in setup mode as directed, it found my network, and that was it. Works perfectly.

I have found it to be pretty accurate. A few times I have noticed a sudden jump up of my weight from one day to the next, but when I have stepped on it again it came back to within an expected range of my previous weight. The day to day measurements are somewhat less important than the long-term trend, which is what Aria is best at. It does seem to matter how you stand on it, but I think this is true of every scale I have owned. The website has very nice graphs of weight, BMI, fat %, fat vs. lean, over a variety of time periods (from one week up to every reading Aria has recorded). Given the amount of data the One and the Aria collects, I have a feeling that more analytics might be rolled out on the website in the future. All of your data is kept as private as you wish. The Fitbit site also has a community forum, but I like the MFP one better.

I love the integration with the Fitbit website and with My Fitness Pal. Between those two sites, the Aria and the Fitbit One, I feel like I have a lot more tools to reach my health goals.

title: Venerable and uniquely delicious UK spin on ginger/root beer/sarsaparilla!
text: This historic UK stuff (google it for history) is both unique and fantastic (and though carbonated is not "soda", if you please -- it's a "botanical brew!"). You either relish the "bitter herbs meet cola meet ginger ale meet root beer" flavor or you don't, but I do and greatly regret it's discontinuance at the local fine foods market. It may be like Chef Rick Bayless's Frontera "two chiles" salsa -- far the best item in their product line, but not the best selling (apparently ConAgra dropped it when Bayless sold out). text:

Pros:
Automatically uploads weight data to fitbit profile. Let's face it... that's it. You could upload your weight to fitbit or any other fitness tracker site or app manually with a regular scale. The scale's ability to accurately measure body fat is probably questionable and how many people actually benefit from having that information?

Cons:
Having to replace battery. An annoyance, even with rechargeable ones ready. Seems to require frequent changing.
Fitbit service not compatible with any other fitness trackers. Understandable, but still frustrating.
Scale broke as soon as it would not be covered under warranty.
Extremely expensive for what it is.

A scale as expensive as this should not be built with cheap parts that cause it to break after a couple of years of normal use. If you think the price is worth the convenience of not having to manually keep track of your weight for a couple of years, then this might be the scale for you.

title: Do Your Research
text:
I bought this because I'm trying to bleach black leather boots. I give this product 4 stars because I'm not sure if this is a user error or not. It arrived well packaged, clean, easy to use and keep safe. I did extensive research on how to bleach leather and followed the directions meticulously. I prepared my leather, trying multiple methods and prepared the bleach solution. This package doesn't come with instructions, so I had to go off of the reading I'd done. I mixed 30ml (2 tbsp) dry with 2 cups of room temperature water. I placed my leather in this solution for 10 minutes, allowed 10 minutes to dry. This did nothing. So I gradually turned up the amount of time I let the leather soak and dry. At the longest, it was left soaking for 3 hours and dried for over 24. No difference.
All I can think is that I either didn't properly deglaze (although I spent a great deal of time on that), I need to increase my oxalic acid to water ratio so the solution is more potent, or I need to somehow strip the dye from the leather instead of bleaching.
I plan on spending more time deglazing my surface and increasing my solution.
I'll try to remember to report back once I have, but right now, this product has failed me epically.

title: Love this but watch video and read the instructions first
text:
I never write reviews but I love this product so much I felt like I needed to share this wonderful product with everyone.
Before getting my silicone makeup sponge, I was using a beauty blender. It was fine and doing the job well, but it was never clean and soaked up a ton of product. I bought the silicone sponge after hearing about it in beauty blogs and being curious.
I read some reviews and settled on this one from Sano Naturals. The reviews said that the company would send you an email with instructions on how to use it along with a video. Read those instructions and watch the video! This is not supposed to be used like a beauty blender, but it's supposed to have the makeup sit on top of the skin and be absorbed that way.
It took some getting used to, but once I got the hang of it, I truly fell in love. My foundation was running low before I bought the silicone sponge, and after using it for 3 weeks, I am still using the same bottle. 5 pumps of foundation from my old beauty blender is equivalent to 2 pumps for this silicone sponge and it provides the same amount of coverage. I also love that I can clean it completely when I'm done.
I highly recommend this product to help with your makeup application.

title: Kid-oriented
text:
I am expecting our first baby and have been shopping for a perfect baby memory book. I've looked at quite a few and narrowed my choice to (1) Zoophabet Looseleaf AND (2) Blue Booties Record Book. However, while the latter one (Booties) is VERY cute and classy, it's more parent-oriented (nice to put on a shelf, looks crisP and classic, etc), a Zoophabet one is so much more KID-ORIENTED. After all, the memory book is for the baby when he/she is old enough to be interested in where he/she came from. I remember myself looking through my baby book and album hundreds of times over and over again, so I guess my kid would also appreciate the book made specially for him.

Also, Zoophabet will serve great for learning purposes as well, since there's a letter on each page denoting something (e.g. M is for Mommy, D is for Daddy). It also has very fun and cute pictures of animals that would be very fun for little kids.

Besides, it doesn't have stupid "fill-ins" that kind of force you to write what you wouldn't otherwise. AND it has two clear plastic folders/pockets for all kinds of memorablia + a bunch of sturdy white paper sheets for journaling, scrapbooking or extra pics.

Make sure to check it out in a store though to be able to fully evaluate the book. I personally absolutely loved it. And, as somebody mentioned before, it IS gender-neutral :).

title: Life Changing
text:
Playfullness and exuberance are words that we have come to associate with childhood play. Adult play is ,mostly, highly regulated and contrived. How did we surrender our spontaneity and joy of movement? Animals (adults and young, play) stretch, run, stalk and rest: they do not Train or Workout, so why should adult humans not live in similar vein?
The Modern Sedentary Culture of developed countries has robbed us of our movement heritage. We must move to be well and we must move with joy and exuberance to offset the atrophy induced by prolonged sittting. I have a lot of issues with my lower back / tailbone and hips, and I sit at a computer for the greater portion of every day. The design of the material provides an overall firm feel, but allows all the problem points on my bottom to sink in just enough. The Royal model is fairly heavy, but the cover with handle allows me to easily carry it. The gel material itself does have quite a strong plastic smell, but once inside the cover, it's not much of an issue. If you are looking for pressure point relief, rather than just a cushy for your tushy, this model performs quite well.

title: Serves its purpose, but not high quality
text: Positives include larger inflatable tires that do help absorb shock from small bumps, a well designed and sturdy frame, seat design that allows use as a foot stool or kneeling sideways, which as a man with a broken ankle, I found useful for going to the bathroom.  Negatives include overall build quality of components.  As a bike enthusiast, it pains me to see this style of brake but it’s better than nothing.  The assembly and tuning of the brake levers was also disappointing.  It took some tuning to get the brakes and brake lock functioning properly (something that many may not know how to do if they’re unfamiliar with bicycle brake adjustments).  The basket is not secure at all and in fact one of the prongs that it rests on just fell off all of a sudden so I ended up hammering the other prong off and zip tied the basket to the bracket, which seems to be much more secure now anyway.  At least one of the tires have a hop in it so it’s not the smoothest ride.  All terrain is certainly a stretch of the imagination also. The pump that came with it is a joke and completely useless so be prepared with another air pump because all the tires came deflated, at least for me.  The handlebars and overall handling do not instill much confidence especially right away, but I’ve gotten used to it now.  It just feels more wobbly than a scooter for this purpose should, in my opinion.  You would think safety and security would be a priority for the target market here.  I also find the foldability  to be somewhat of a gimmick.  If you own an SUV, it’s certainly not necessary.  I guess perhaps with a small compact car it could be useful but it really isn’t that large of a scooter to begin with and would fit in most back seats or hatchbacks just fine.  All that said, I guess it’s about on par for what I would have expected for something made in china and at this price point.  Bottom line, it serves its purpose around the house and in public stores and what not, but I wouldn’t put much faith in it going down any significant hills or over larger bumps common on some sidewalks where I live.  So for that reason, I’m content with the purchase but not overly happy or impressed with it and would probably recommend trying a different scooter to a friend or family member if I’m honest.

title: This product did NOT work for me.
text:
I purchased this item in anticipation of a pre-employment test. I actually bought 2 as I wanted to test this product myself for its effectiveness prior to any other tests. I took the product as directed. Prior to my own testing, I drank 10 bottles of water (5 bottles each day). I ate my last meal 3 hrs before drinking. I drank the entire bottle (not gross but also not delicious). I refilled the bottle and waited 20 minutes. I drank the water and waited another 40 minutes before testing any samples. After waiting the 40 minutes, I used a home test to test the sample. It appeared as though I "may" have passed with this sample (the 2nd line was EXTREMELY faint but the argument could be made that there was a 2nd line visible). At this point, I was feeling good about the product and thought that any further test would result in a "more" positive test result. I took and sampled 3 more tests (at 1 hr intervals) and every subsequent test was a clear FAIL.
To be fair, I am a very large male, which is why I chose this product (intended for use by "large body mass" individuals). And, everybody's body is different, so it may have just not worked for me and your results may be different. I just won't be buying this product again in the future. Good luck!

title: Could be better quality, but it works.
text:
Let me preface this review by saying that I am an African American and I have fine, but coarse hair. I will update this review with before/after pictures later. I don't have the patience for straightening my hair with a flat iron all of the time and I'm not particularly good with one, in the first place. This brush straightener serves a good purpose for me where I am able to straighten my hair in a shorter period time. It usually takes an hour for me to flat iron my hair by myself, but with the brush, I can get it straighter in 20-25 minutes. In previous reviews, people mentioned that the on/off button is inconveniently located where your thumb rests to straighten your hair, but as long as I don't grip it too hard, I don't run into the problem of turning it off mid-process.

Now to the cons:

The brush gets hot, but the design of the brush only allows my hair to be as straight as a perfect blow drying job (not silky straight). After a couple days, my natural kinks return. This is probably where I should mention that this product would be more effective on permed hair.

The quality of this product needs some improvement. As someone mentioned in a previous review, the brush tips do bend and over time, they will probably fall off. Also, as a safety concern and pure annoyance, the plug fits loosely into the socket and will easily come unplugged if you move too far away (the cord is also short). This is truly annoying, as I have to constantly plug it back in and reset the temperature.

Because it is a brush design, hair will get trapped and clearing that out is a pain, something that you wouldn't have to experience with a flat iron.

FINAL VERDICT: This product is great for non-coarse hair and if you want to straighten your hair quickly, but if you are a pro with a flat iron or have natural, coarse hair, I would steer clear for now.

title: Just remember to replace cartridge every 2-3months no matter # of flushes
text:
In terms of usage, this system requires some getting used to. It works well when there is "weight" after each use, i.e. the flush (suction and twist) needs the weight to operate well. I dump 1-2 cup of cat litter down each time and this has worked well.

More importantly, and don't make the same mistake I did - regardless of how many flushes you've done (spec says 10-15 flushes), always always replace the cartridge after 2-3 months. Otherwise the bag will biodegrade and you will have a mess to clean up!

This interval varies depending on many factors such as air temperature. I left mine after a few trial use for 5 months and liquid leaked out into the white plastic bucket. At first there was no smell, over time I noticed the faint smell that grew worst and upon investigation found liquid in the white bucket. This came through two layers of bags - the tinfoil twisty bag and the black garbage bag, both came with the cartridge purchase.

The takeaway is to always replace the cartridge after some fixed amount of time even if you've not flushed 10-15 times.

title: Finally a solution to my clenching!
text: I've only been wearing this for 3 days. I've been a clencher for about 7 years now, and it was pretty easily managed with another brand mouth guard up until I had an accident a year and a half ago. Since then, it seems like my clenching got worse or my muscles were different...I don't know, but it caused me near daily headaches and jaw pain. lately, it's been so bad that I use a heat pad daily (multiple times), and was constantly massaging the side of my jaw that I clench on, stretching my jaw, and trying my hardest to lie down with my jaw shifted to the other side to relieve the pain. Nothing worked. I'd reset any food I did whenever I slept because I'd go right back to clenching.  It sucked. An ent (for another unrelated problem) suggested I get an "anti snore" mouthguard, even though I don't snore. He said it would set my lower jaw forward so I couldn't clench...but I wasn't okay with the price, and didn't like the idea of having such a huge contraption in my mouth to sleep, so I started googling. Found this and got it 100% because of the amazing reviews. Day 1, I woke up and didn't need to massage my jaw just so my bite would fit together. Pain returned late at night once I started to get tired. For half the day though, my jaw felt tight, but more normal than it had in awhile. Day two, same thing, but the headache seemed more manageable. I'm now at the end of day 3, and have gone the whole day without feeling the need to massage my jaw or "set" it back into place (I have some BIG strong knots from years of intense clenching). I feel like those knots are starting to give. I am really optimistic this will be a great long term solution...if I'm feeling this much better after 3 days, I can't wait to see what 3 weeks, months, years are like! This is GREAT for clenchers  (I don't grind), and I could see it working well for grinders too because it comfortably holds your back teeth apart, just a little bit. Fits snugly, molding is easy, and hasn't shifted my teeth out of place. WAY better than mouth guards that sit between your back upper and lower teeth because it PREVENTS the ability to grind or clench. 5 stars!!

title: Simply the BEST!
text:
I have had severe dry skin on my feet since I was a child. My skin can crack to the point that it bleeds if I am not careful. I have tried every type of lotion and cream out there, including callous removing gel and Bag Balm. Heel Tastic is the best product I have ever used. There is an immediate improvement to my skin after just one use. I usually apply the product before I go to bed and use a pair of socks overnight. Unlike Bag Balm, it washes out of your socks. It does not leave an oily residue by the following morning.

The product also works great on your hands (Use gloves). I have even used it as chapstick in a pinch.

I do not recommend buying any other brand. They are not as effective as this brand. CVS Pharmacy used to sell a product like this under their store brand. It worked as well as Heel Tastic. However, they stopped carrying the product.

I highly recommend buying this product.

title: Great if it's what you're looking for
text:
A decently priced pair of shades. Fairly big, I will warn that small faced people or people that just don't like bigger shades should look at another item entirely. They fill your face well, and if that's what you desire then look no further. They aren't overly dark to the point where things are too obscured, but they do a good job of keeping the sun out of your eyes.

The plastic is softer than most sunglasses so while I wouldn't recommend getting too rough with them, they will most likely take a bit more impact than other shades. This also leaves room for some very slight (and I stress that word) adjustments if they don't fit your face the way you'd like them to. Mine came out of the box with the frames a little off in relation to one another and I was able to carefully bend then into symmetry.

The price is great for what you get, so I would say buy them if bigger shades are your preference.

title: Boiling for 15 minutes a must.
text:
Received 2 tires today. My brother and I boiled each tire for 15 minutes.

Meanwhile we removed the wheels off of the Drive TR18. We found working with the wheel off allows you easy access to the rim from the back. Note that this model requires you to press the hub cap in so the ball bearing that keep the nut on the axle normally will allow the nut to pass over.

Use zip ties to hold the tire as you work it around the rim. About 3/4 of the way, you'll need the heavy duty screwdrivers or heavy tire irons to get the tire on the rest of the way. Two people make it go easier. Make sure the tire is seated properly on both sides all around.

Took us about an hour total. Would suggest strongly diagonal cutting pliers to cut through old tire's cords.

text:
I am rating fitbit weight scale a one and thinking about sending it back! I am of the older generation who believe the customer is always right. The customer is not to be taken for granted and is the reason your enterprise exists.

title: The Great Unknown Cure for Nausea
text:
Vomiting caused internal tear that sent me to ER. Docs sent me home with pills whose side effects include (you guessed it) nausea and vomiting. As nausea rolled in a couple days later, I realized I could be heading towards vomiting and another expensive ER visit, I remembered the Reliefband that got my wife through two phases of long, dose-dense chemo without ever vomiting once. I scrambled through the house and found it in time, strapped it on, and cranked it up to 5 immediately. 40 minutes later I was eating dinner and watching my thumb twitch as the device did its zappy little thing.

I see one review that complained about the uncomfortable feeling of the zapping. To each his own. When I'm nauseous, I will literally let you hit my thumb with a hammer if that will put an end to it.

It is true, there is a "knack" to using it. Getting it positioned right and tight and keeping it from "moving" as you do lots of other stuff can be a bit of hassle. But nausea makes me want to die, so none of those hassles bother me so long as the thing works.

First time I borrowed my wife's Reliefband, I was hopeful but not confident it would work. Half hour later when I realized the nausea was gone, I thought "well, it could just be coincidence" and turned it off thinking, of course, nausea certainly can go away on its own. Minutes later I was pounding that button to turn it up to 5, as the nausea came rolling back.

It's a tragedy so few clinicians know that there is a non-drug antidote for nausea that works nearly like a miracle for many of us.

title: Worked well for me. Make sure hands are dry when dispensing the soap sheets.
text: I’ve taken these on all my extended trips for the past several years. I love this product. I use it for any small hand-washable items: undergarments and lingerie, washable scarves, tank tops, etc. What I like most: it is very very lightweight and takes up almost no room in a suitcase. No liquid to spill. It works! Need to know: use with dry hands and keep away from water. The very thin little soap wafers/leaves/sheets will dissolve or stick together in the container if the package gets wet or is touched with wet fingers. I use several sheets/leaves in a sink/basin of water, despite directions that say only one sheet is enough. I found that swirling and churning them in the water with my hand creates suds and mixes it well. I then soak the items to be washed in the soapy water for a while, then rub and squeeze to wash. I rinse the items well to get all the soap out. For my purposes this works so well I have used up and re-purchased it several times. I will continue to take it on all my trips.

title: Blade is dull; hence unit is prone to crushing pills. Also design is unusable for oversized pills.
text:
Bit more experience, so I have to tweak my review.

Still not convinced the blade is any good, but it's become clear that the problem is with the specific pills we're trying to cut; they're just too big. Meaning that in our case, it's the plastic shell that holds the blade in place that is crushing the pill before the blade even has a chance of applying any significant force. Otherwise, my original opinion, below, is unchanged. I still think the blade is too dull for the job, but I cannot rigorously attest to that as we've had no cause to split the size pills it's clearly designed to handle.

Two different units are both doing the same thing, and due to careless advertising (can't be sure if this is the seller's or Amazon's fault) I have two more that I can test with. But I'm fully expecting the same results.

Bought this to handle 1,500mg "horse" pill, which just barely fit; however, the description clearly states (I am paraphrasing) "Works with all pills; small, large, and will not crush".

Well, between myself and my wife, we've now used this on about a dozen pills, and the result has been the same every time. Crushed pills; frequently into powder. Yet we can split these same pills, without issue, with a simple pair of decent quality scissors.

"Didn't follow the instructions"; um, what instructions? Not to mention the function is so bloody obvious that no instructions are needed. However, I tried both gentle, firm pressure, and just straight-up hard pressure--gentle and firm did nothing but test my patience; it certainly did not work. Hard pressure worked but ... powder, or at best large chunks.

"Clearly the blade is dull" I thought, and some quick testing confirmed that. Indeed, these blades can't even cut paper, so how can they be expected to handle pills that are much denser?

Good idea; OK design, but the piss-poor blade ruins the whole thing.

And sorry, the "Must protect the children; that's why the blades aren't as sharp as they could be" excuse doesn't fly with me. No aware parent would allow a young child anywhere near this thing, dull blade or not.

title: best Fresh Whole Leaf Irish Moss (Raw, Wildcrafted) i've tried
text: Irish moss, or carrageen moss is a species of seaweed which grows abundantly along the rocky parts of the Atlantic coast of Europe and the Americas as well as parts in the Pacific. In its fresh condition the plant is soft and cartilaginous, varying in color from a greenish-yellow, through red, to a dark purple or purplish-brown. The principal constituent of Irish moss is a mucilaginous body, made of the polysaccharide Carragenan of which it contains about 55%; the plant also has nearly 10% of protein and about 15% minerals, specifically rich in iodine and sulfur. Because of the abundant cell wall polysaccharides it will form a jelly when boiled or processed with water expanding from 20 to 100 times of its weight.
