title: Formula change
text:
Product Change: please be aware that the product has changed significantly. I’ve used the ‘astringent pads’ for years and have been beyond pleased with the results!

Recently, I refreshed my supply and purchased 2 containers using my same supplier on amazon as i have consistently used for awhile now. I noticed something different immediately. The pads were more ‘squishy’ and when I used the first one, it rendered an unusual scent along with FOAMY residue. I thought I purchased the wrong product and actually wondered if it was a cleanser instead of just the witch hazel toner I had been so pleased with for years. I confirmed that the name of the product was the same.

I called the company and was told there was ‘no change to the formula.’ It was recommended that I try purchasing from Target as they contract directly with Thayer and this would rule out any possible mock product concerns.

I purchased the product at Target. Same results. I’ve tried continued use and am now seeing a severe reaction in the form of a red, irritating rash.

I have very sensitive skin which is why I chose this product and medium in the first place.

I then did some research and found that indeed others have reported similar experiences and results.

I highly recommend that we hold Thayer accountable for disclosing product formula changes. We rely on our tried and true products and trusted companies to be transparent and to allow us the opportunity to make our decisions based on fact and accurate information.

Very disappointed.

Besides that the racks did the job, I was able to transport two 10 feet Kayaks from point A to point B (about 50 miles distance) without a problem. In my case, these racks will be used about twice or three times a year while I relocated the kayaks between places where we are going to use them, so they are good enough for me. If you are planning to use them constantly, then you might want a known brand one that have better material quality. title: Amazing Little Thing
text:
Easily the most effective facial device I've used so far!

Hada Crie is Japan's #1 bestselling facial cleansing and moisturizing gadget line! I know we hear it all the time: "#1 bestseller this", "Top-selling that", but in this case, I think it might actually be true. It's wildly popular both in Japan and also worldwide (a simple google search will show you that).

The device's appearance is so appealing! Lightweight, cute, and easy to use. It looks like a cute plastic toy, but the metal plate is where the MAGIC happens. It releases both positive and negative ions and is what cleanses, moisturize and minimize pores on the skin.

Some people compare it to the Clarisonic, however, I bought the Clarisonic and used it for a month, the abrasive brush really didn't appeal to me. I felt like my face was the toilet and Clarisonic was the toilet brush, too harsh on my face! And I think Clarisonic only brushes the dead skincells on the superficial surface away, not really doing anything deep down. With prices about the same for both devices, I'd definitely go with Hada Crie!

Also, it's great that we don't have to use any specialized products with Hada Crie. So you can use your existing skincare products. At the start, I was super confused trying to decide when to use what, but after a little research on the world wide web and some experimenting, I've found the device is quite flexible. You can try many different products and find out what products work best for your skin - switching cotton pads, toners, essence, etc. The KEY is to experiment and find out what works best for YOUR skin. I think of it as a treasure hunt, trying to dig out my treasure~
Keep in mind: Make sure you start with a relatively clean face, this CANNOT be used to remove makeup! Make sure to soak the cotton pad so that it won't make gliding the device over your face abrasive, but not too much that it will ooze liquid when you press it against your skin either.

I also want to praise Hada Crie for its amazing user experience. Using it feels like I'm treating myself to a facial at the spa. I do the routine while watching TV or listening to music before bed, I find it super relaxing. This little thing is also so smart that you will know if you are not holding it right. And the vibrations actually briefly pauses if you pull the device away from the face, then continues the 5-min cycle when you put it back on the face. Kinda amazing how it knows... :)

Now the RESULTS, using Hada Crie I was able to see how much dirt and grime was captured in the used cotton pads. It was quite disgusting but it shows how much dirt I still had even after washing my face. My pores are definitely smaller and I was very satisfied when I touched my face and found that they were obviously more plump. It really felt "bouncier" and like it was boosted with moisture! Love it!

I don't agree with the comment of "not having enough time to use this". Hada Crie is actually very flexible in terms of usage. I can use each step separately as needed, and don't have to commit to the 5-min if I was in a hurry. For example, I use step 3 Moisturize mode alone in the morning for 1 min or so, and sometimes at night I just use step 1 Cleansing and step 3 Moisturize, and if I get real lazy, I only use step 1. So I really didn't think it was a burden at all, rather, I was looking forward to washing my face each night!

The battery life is great too. I bought it about 15+ days ago, been using it every night and sometimes during the morning as well, and I've only charged it once so far! Just for 5 hours as instructed when I first received it!

Hada Crie has already become my holy grail~! Definitely the best investment I made this year and I highly recommend it!

title: I LOVE my chair!
text: I’ve had my chair for almost three years now. I have a power chair the military gave me for use in my house but it’s heavy and bulky and leaves me house or yard bound. My husband and I retired, and we wanted to get an RV and travel, do things together, but as any one stuck in a manual chair knows who can’t push themselves (I have a damaged arm from a surgery and can’t push myself) that leaves you at the mercy of others - you can go when they feel like taking you. Not that my husband didn’t want to take me, but I didn’t want to drag him through sewing stores and women’s clothing departments. I wanted to go where I wanted to shop while he went his way. Then came this chair and I was set free. He can lift it into the car or the back of the truck - it only weighs 65 lbs.! I can even go walking on trails if they are not too steep and wide enough. Yes, some of the little things could be better - the plastic stoppers in the ends of the posts fell out pretty quickly, and now the rubber around the controller is wearing, but we’ve dragged this thing all over the country for three years from Florida to Washington state, Arizona to the UP of Michigan, on trails, dirt roads, through malls and museums, and I wouldn’t trade it for the world. And people who see me out and about stop me to ask all the time and I recommend it wholeheartedly.

title: This is really a solid.. solid fuel.
text:
Split the tab into 2 equal pieces, placing them 1" apart on an Esbit stove. Did this test at the college I attend; used an IR temp. sensor gun... because I wanted to play with it! Lighting the corner of each block took about 5 seconds of direct flame from a crappy cigarette lighter. After a minute or so, the top and sides of each block were producing flame. For the next 8 minutes, the average heat output with the gun pointing right above the tablet was 1130F. For the next 4 minutes: 890F. Peaked around 1200F. Occasionally brushing the tablet off increases the heat output but you in turn lose burning time.

We brought a pint of water to a boil in just over 8 minutes. I believe these should be a staple in any outdoor-going bag. The most common fuel stoves that are used for these types of tablets can hold 4 of these tablets easily making the entire setup extremely compact. I personally carry one hunting; it's aaaalmost odorless and a (insert favorite hot food here) tastes WAY better than anything cold on an even colder day.

title: Worked as advertised and made our trip so much easier.
text:
Bought the Pro Series 60" x 24" cargo carrier and this waterproof bag for a trip from North Carolina to Illinois and back. Filled it to the stretching point with the luggage of six people so we could utilize all the seats in our SUV. The bag's footprint was a perfect fit for the cargo carrier. 1200 total miles over 10 days, no tears, no rips, no holes, no wet luggage.

Chose this set-up instead of a top carrier to avoid loss of MPG. We saw no discernible change to our gas mileage while using this product. Also having the luggage at this level made accessing individual items much easier and we avoided the need to lift heavy luggage over our heads. There is no specific way to lock this bag, but since it is soft sided a thief could just as easily cut it open with a utility knife. Let vigilance be your security.

Heavy duty zipper accepted the punishment of the bag being overfilled, but did not break or separate. The top flap design overlapped the zipper and sturdy velcro held it in place. We made certain that the zipper and flap faced to the rear so water from the tires would not splash up into it, which is the only way water might end up in the bag. Drove through a lot of rain and water on the road, everything stayed nice and dry.

Tie down straps looked odd and a little small at first, but once we read the instruction and put them in place, they were sturdy and more than up the task. I suppose if the cargo weighed a lot more than the carrier should hold and your driving was more erratic than the law allows you could force it to shift and bounce around to the point that straps might not hold it. Otherwise the tie down straps do the job. When adjusted they do leave a long strap 'tail' to blow in the wind. Learn to tie the tails down to avoid them slapping around.

Bag is sturdy, but if you fold it back up the way it was originally shipped, it takes up very little storage space.

title: Fantastic Rotary Shaver at an AMAZING price!
text:
I've used foil shavers for years to "clean up" in between shaves with standard razors. Since I also sport the Bruce Willis/Cpt Picard shaved head look, I have a ton of real-estate to cover and, since the "hermit mountain man" look doesn't fit well with my corporate job, I pretty much have to use an electric so I'm clean shaven without the pain and irritation of shaving with a razor everyday.

I've never used a Rotary shaver before this one so I can't compare it to anything else. However, since my facial hair grows so fast, I've always bought the top of the line foil shavers because I figured if they cost so much, they've got to last, travel well, and do a pretty decent job of cleaning up before a meeting. For me, price equalled quality.

So, I'm on the hunt for a new electric and I came across the DynaBliss 3D. I'd always wanted to try out a rotary but, with the money I'd spend on one of the high-end models, I was always hesitant because of the nagging,"what if I hate it?" However, for less than a quarter of what I'd spent on just one of the "high-end" foils, I figured who cares if I hate it. I'd just regift it if it was awful.

Well, I'd gone about three days without a shave when this arrived and I was literally itching (stupid stubble) to try this thing out. Then I remembered I'd need to charge it first and I was pleasantly surprised to find that it came FULLY charged!

The quality of this razor is immediately evident when you get it out of the package. For less than $40.00, I was expecting a cheap, light razor but it actually feels substantial and is amazingly ergonomic. As for the performance, quite frankly I was shocked! Definitely have to use a different circular motion to this versus a foil but it was easy to get used to because of the design. The rotary heads flex and pivot just as described and, even with my longer and super course stubble, I got a MUCH closer shave than I ever did with my overpriced foils; especially around my chin and neck.

Due to a couple of brain surgeries (brain cancer), I have a LARGE scar on the right side of my head that's always been hit or miss with electrics. The DynaBliss 3D handled my whole head and face (including that scar) like a champ! Seriously, I'm a true believer in rotary shavers now!

That whole shave took me down to about 90% power (it took a while to get used to the rotary motion versus a foil). I plugged it in (with a standard micro-USB cable: BRILLIANT!) and it took less than five minutes to get back to 100% charge. This thing is ridiculously well made with an amazing battery!

Long story short, I couldn't be happier and plan on getting another one just to keep in my travel bag for business trips!

title: Work for sandals, too!
text:
I love those leather insoles for my sandals! In fact I’m so happy with them I’m going to order a second pair!
Initially i was searching some gel pads to rescue my sore feet and knees from walking miles in my summer sandals. I love how stylish and versatile my sandals are, but the soles are very thin and flat and provide no arch support. To my disappointment it seems all orthopedic insoles are specifically designed for flats, heels, or boots, none of them are for sandals. I contemplated to give these a try, since they look the closest to what I wanted. Leather insoles are a pleasant find and much appreciated! My feet tend to sweat a lot so I only buy sandals with leather insoles anyway. Also the silhouette is sleek enough, not very noticeable when put on. They blend well with the sandals. I actually worried that they might slip and shift after walking for extended period of time, since sandals cannot hold them in place like flats or boots, but the adhesive bottom are pretty strong! I walk to work everyday (2 miles one way), and today is the first day I wore them. So glad they stayed in place all day and provide just enough cushion and shock absorbtion for my knees. Plus my feet doesn’t feel nasty nor did they stink! They are the perfect solution to my problem! I can’t say enough good things about them!

title: This is really a seller rating
text:
This collar looked to be the perfect solution to my problems, but there is no way to tell because the seller, MedicalRite, wouldn't ship to me here in the U.S. Virgin Islands. I can understand when sellers have contracts with UPS or Fedex and don't want the hassle of going to the Post Office. Fine, but say so, When I was informed by Amazon that the seller had canceled the order, I sent the seller a message asking if they could send it Priority Mail in a Flat Rate box, for which I would happily pay the cost (which would have equaled the cost of the collar itself). After more than a week I have heard nothing back from the vendor - not a yes, we can help or a no, we don't want to help; just nothing at all. Not even so much as a kiss my a**. This is a horrible way to run a business. It takes maybe a minute to fire off an email saying yes or no. Failing to do so indicates that the customer means nothing to this vendor.

I was unable to find a way to rate just the vendor, rather than the item itself, but had no luck. The product may well be all that it claims, but the vendor has such poor customer service that I'd suggest obtaining this elsewhere or trying another similar product from a better vendor. I got a similar Laerdal "Stiffneck Select" from BP Medical Supplies through Amazon and it cost a dollar less than the collar from MedicalRite. It was ordered, shipped and arrived, and I still haven't heard a word from MedicalRIte. Avoid them if you can.

title: I love this sunscreen
text:
I love this sunscreen! I've been searching for the perfect water resistant sunscreen for two years now. I've tried everything with a low EWG rating and haven't been pleased with any of it.

My number one requirement for a family sunscreen is a 1 rating on the EWG site. I'd almost resigned myself to the idea that all 1's are thick, greasy, difficult to rub in, and leave you looking white. Badger Balm was the best I found previously to Sun'N'Fun but it was sooooo greasy that I dreaded putting it on myself. It took way too long to rub it into my toddler's skin and anyone with a toddler knows time is of the essence when applying sunscreen to a squirming, sunscreen resistant child.

This month I found Sun'N'Fun and my search is over. It's not the least bit greasy! It's thicker than your non mineral sunscreens but rubs in easily and leaves almost no white. It smells wonderful.

I bought 3 tubes before I even ran out of my first because I knew I'd found my new sunscreen. I highly recommend this sunscreen.

My only wish is that they made larger tubes. We live in Texas and swim nine months of the year so we go through a tube a month fort the two of us. Still you get a 10% discount when you order three tubes so that's my plan.

title: They fit easy in the trunk of the car with the rest ...
text:
I bought this product at a golf shop, but feel compelled to provide this review on Amazon as a service to fellow golfers who travel by air ... this bag is incredible. This bag is an exact fit for a complete set of clubs and their head covers. It is light and balanced ... you will not believe how much easier it is to bring your golf clubs on a flight with this bag. They fit easy in the trunk of the car with the rest of your luggage. They are easy to carry around the airport. They are easy to bring in and out of the hotel.

There is a downside ... the clubs are tightly packed in the bag when it is on the back of the cart. I solve this by keeping my putter and wedges out of the bag but inside the strap that holds the bag. Not as convenient as a full size bag, but the convenience of getting your clubs around on the rest of your vacation far outweighs this inconvenience. I do wish they would leave a little extra space at the top, though.

In any case, well worth the price.

title: The assembly was SO easy!
text: My coworker and I were trying to find a stool for the veterinarian we work for.  The one he had for doing dentistry work and other certain procedures wasn't the right height and wasn't adjustable, so his back pain was terrible.  He weighs close to 400 pounds, and the biggest problem we had was finding a stool that could withstand his weight.  It was difficult to find one that could handle the weight, was adjustable, had a big enough seat with enough cushioning, and was affordable.  We gave it to him as a Christmas gift (a couple of weeks before Christmas), so he's been using it for about a month now.  At first, it kept rolling out from under him as he tried to sit on it, so we thought either he wouldn't be using it, or we could get wheel cups for it.  However, after just a few days of using it, he got used to how it moves and has adjusted himself to it.  He now uses it for every dental procedure as well as certain other procedures and his back pain has dramatically improved during these procedures.  The stool has also held up beautifully so far.  I would highly recommend it!

title: BEST affordable ergonomic seating solution!  A+++
text:
I've spent months looking for an affordable, backless, height-adjustable seat. So many "ergonomic" stools, kneeling chairs, yoga ball chairs, drafting stools, and ergonomic desk chairs are astronomically expensive. This is a fantastic, realistic solution for any seating arrangement!

Using a pneumatic, backless stool was originally recommended by my physical therapist. It is a great option which allows your surroundings (computer, desk, study area) to adapt to the changing needs of your body -- as opposed to forcing your body to work within the strict confines of a non-adjustable seating system. I fractured my neck a few years ago in a car accident, and until I found this stool I thought I was doomed to a life of painful studying -- or until I could somehow afford a $500-$1000+ "ergonomic" chair. Now I can study, read, type, write, practice music, and use my sit/stand computer platform all with the same stool.

This stool is very, very comfortable, sturdily built, and has a great adjustment range for height. Unlike other stools, it is nicely padded and the seat has a big enough circumference that it doesn't feel like you're going to fall off. It's very light, and was incredibly easy to put together. HIGHLY, HIGHLY recommended for anyone looking for more mobility and less back pain!

title: Great light but........
text:
I own several ThruNite LED flashlights. They're really great lights at a more then fair price. The reason it didn't get 5 stars from me, on the box that the light came in, it says that a CR123 cell is included which it was not, that's false advertisement. I already own a Neutron 2 AA light which is fantastic ! I wanted something smaller that I could toss in a pocket when the longer 2 AA Neutron isn't doable. They are both rated at 255 Lumens though the smaller 1C will work better in colder weather due to the Lithium CR123 battery. Both lights use a Cree XM-L LED which is pretty much the best currently on the market. I would very highly recommend any light made my ThruNite as they create wonderful flashlights at a very reasonable price. The Neutron series are floodlights, love 'em for walking my dogs at night or lighting up a large area. The switching of brightness levels is quite easy. It does have a disorientating tactical strobe or an SOS mode. All and all, it deserves 5 stars but in the future, if it says on the box, battery included, just include it.
______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

title: Good Value for the price but untrustworthy pregnancy tests
text:
Ok so I purchased this product twice. Hubs and I started TTC January this year. With this product in partner with the clearblue advanced fertility tests we were pregnant by February. However that first try ended in a miscarriage. During this time the pregnancy strips barely ever picked up anything the entire time. We skipped March as I was in the middle of the miscarriage and tried again in April. Again with these tests and clear blue we got pregnant again. This time it seems that this little bean is sticking. Thank God! These ovulation tests work great. However I think they work even better in partnership with other products. It’s better to be able to compare between two things. Clearblue showed me 8days of high fertility and 4 of peak fertility whereas these strips only showed me 4 days of “peak”.

Now on to the pregnancy tests.

They are super super unreliable. I included comparison pics above between two different brands (First response and These) you can clearly see the progression difference between the two. I barely got a dark positive on these tests yesterday, which just so happens to be a week after getting my first positive first response. They say they are supposed to pick up at 10 for hcg. I am here to tell you that is false. I had a blood test on the 22nd and this past Tuesday. Tuesday my results came back at 220. Still no bright test yet I was getting dye stealing Clear blue tests and super dark first responses. Who knows what my hcg is now tho but it is for sure over 220. So I think that makes these very unreliable because you could think that your out of the race when these take a very very long time to register. And yes before you all ask I only tested when I first woke up every morning to make sure it was super concentrated.

title: Powerful.
text: Wow. This stuff is powerful. I was first introduced to Lion's Mane/ Chaga/Reishi in Four Sigmatic mushroom coffee a while back but I wanted to have more control over the quality and quantity of the adaptogens. Despite being USDA certified organic, most mushrooms come from China. I'm from China and visit regularly so I can attest to just how polluted the environment is. Even without the use of pesticides and chemical fertilizers, there is no way you can control the contamination in the soil and water supply. This is why I make sure to check the origin of any USDA organic items before I purchase. I'm glad that I was able to find a US grown source of adaptogenic mushrooms. I have been using Reishi powder from Sun Potion in my morning coffee and rotate that with He Shou Wu and Chaga mushroom powder. Today I decided to try Lion's Mane for the first time and added a little under a teaspoon. I was buzzed the entire day. It's now 9:30pm and I'm still zoned in and completely focused. Of course every person is different, but this is how my body reacted. I will keep taking it but recommend starting with a low dosage and rotating between supplements.

title: Awesome gadget
text: When I first opened the dog grooming set, I was skeptical. Even thought everything was nicely packaged.  It came with three attachments and is battery operated.  It also came with a brush to clean the attachments. It also came with a cord to charge. First I charged the trimmer for twenty four hours.  The batteries were powerful enough though.  I am not a professional groomer although I have groomed Doodles and Maltese multiple times. 74 The trimmers worked very nicely with our Maltese. And are great for that in between grooming appointments.  I used the trimmers around my doodles faces and they worked well. Not as good as the professional clippers that we have. Doodles have more coarse hair then our Maltese.  I  am afraid to try to use the clippers to do a full shave because the last I want to do is burn out the clippers. Heavy duty clippers ( professional) should only be used for a full shave. I bought these with the intentions of cutting around their eyes, beards, and in between their toes. 176 The trimmers work perfect for these areas. Again, I am not a professional groomer, and I am not used to cutting or filing down our dogs nails. Luckily we have dogs who loved to be groomed and pampered, so our dogs will just sit on the couch with their paws on a towel in my lap while I filed their nails. Again the filing tool worked great for our little Maltese. As for the Doodles it seemed to take way longer and did not seem powerful enough. After filing my dog Thias nails for ten minutes on one paw, I really could not notice too much of a difference between the filed paw and not filed paw . I would personally recommend this product to anyone who has furry animals for maintaining their animals nails or for small trims.  The attachments are extremely easy to take off and put on. The package it small enough that it is great for traveling or compact storage.  The product is extremely easy to clean. 346 If you are afraid to file or trim your dogs nails because you are afraid of hurting them by filing the nails too short then the filing attachment will work perfectly for you. I personally would  start to feel nauseous while trying to file or trim our doggies nails but with this attachment it is impossible to file the nails too short. 409 The little grips on the side of the tool make it safer to trim without your hands slipping and then you end up with a chunk of fur missing. I do feel that the batteries worked way stronger then the charged system. The trimmers also were not as loud as other clippers that we have and have used in the past.  Our professional clippers are so loud that they scare our Maltese and we are not able to calm him down enough to even let the clippers get near him. The sound freaks him out so much. With these clippers the sound is so soft or low that he doesn’t even stress out.

title: Dirt Dropper is my choice of wash bucket guards.
text:
Anyone who is in to Auto Detailing knows the benefit of some form of "guard" in the bottom of their wash bucket to prevent dirt & grit from swirling around in the wash bucket and being transferred back on to the vehicles paint.
I compared three of these "guards" and purchased two for my buckets.
One is the Grit Guard, probably the most common guard out there in while it is a nice design I quickly became tired with putting my arm to the very bottom of the wash bucket to scrub my lambswool mitt and soaking my arm up to my elbow with each rinse.
The Dirt Dropper has the benefit of the Grit Guard while offering another benefit-
a side "washboard to scrub the dirt out of your mitt with a bottom guard to keep the dirt where it belongs, in the bottom of your wash bucket.It is made of much thicker plastic than the Grit Guard and has a stainless steel screw to secure it to the side of your wash bucket so even with aggressive scrubbing it stays in place.
Why only 4 out of 5 stars?
I feel the bottom guard should be more like the Grit Guard to allow less turbulence in the bottom of the bucket as the Dirt Drpper is more wide open than the Grit Guard but even with this design it still is my first choice in guards.

title: Used for my skin
text:
Just to be clear since each product I click on shows a different bottle:
My bottle has a white label and says "soothes sensitivity, good ear health, minor ailments, child safe"
ingredients listed are : "sweet almond oil, eucalyptus oil, tea tree oil, mullein extract, echinacea oil, and garlic oil"

I used this one time in my ear for an earache and it worked slightly. I think it is more of a prevention than a treatment. However, I have stress acne on my chin frequently. I read the ingredients on the bottle and realized that most of them are used to treat skin conditions. I put this stuff on my entire face with only a couple of drops on a cotton ball overnight. This morning my whiteheads are just tiny little red dots now. That is amazing. I also have keratosis pilaris, which causes a variety of symptoms, on my face I have redness similar to rosacea. The redness was reduced by this stuff as well. It is a little oily when you first put it on, and that probably went on my pillow over night, but consider this: both tea tree oil and garlic oil are known to be antibacterial and antifungal, so they are likely disinfecting your pillow as well. I usually only wash the pillow cases once a week, but the pillows are a hassle to wash so they only get washed every few months or replaced. This oil is also a lot cheaper than moisturizers or face washes with the same ingredients. Salicylic Acid does not work on my stress acne, now that I am 23. In fact, it probably damages my skin more than anything.

text:
Ideal for someone with limited time but probably not the same as a live birth class... if you're like us and can't make time for a weekly trip to a birth class this is extremely convenient. But if you're not an auditory learner or if have plenty of time to study up on childbirth you could locate some of the information on these discs yourself if you have access to a good pregnancy library or if you're willing to splurge for a few books. A daily commute made this set a cinch for me. There are a lot of discs!

I liked the yoga dvd and I loved the Prenatal Toning routines. The prenatal Cardio dvd requires a birth ball or fitness ball which I did not have. I had to purchase one locally to do the Prenatal Cardio routine which was actually really fun.

The program sort of assumes you've decided to go natural and doesn't really discuss the pros and cons of medicated versus un-medicated birth. It sort of skips that step and goes straight to the how to manage pain without interventions.

If you want assistance making that decision or just prefer to be a self-study, I recommend the Thinking Woman's Guide to a Better Birth (not a fun read but good facts) or Natural Childbirth the Bradley Way (well organized but beware: lots of nude sketches I embarrased myself when I turned the page at the airport). title: Pros and Cons
text:
Ok, so this product is great but the side effects are not.
Pros: I've taken other breast enhancement products but never pure PM powder. I wasn't expecting much from this but thought I'd give it a try. It doesn't taste great so I like to mix it in a fruit puree or some kind of thick juice. Do Not mix it in milk...Bleh! Anyway, In combination with red clover and massage this PM powder worked great. Nothing drastic but my husband definitely felt a difference in about a week. I didn't go up in size but my breasts were fuller and the appearance of my skin improved. I didn't experience any of the acne problems some women get.
Here's the problem...Pueraria Mirifica accumulates in your body. I didn't know this (my husband told me). I started out with around 750 mg/day and everything was great. You're not supposed to exceed 1000mg/day. Since it accumulates in your body I started noticing discomfort around my 10th day of taking it. First I had little headaches and some minor stomach discomfort and diarhea. On the 14th day I had a throbbing headache and was running to the bathroom shortly after eating anything. I decided 4 days of diarhea was enough and stopped taking it. My stomach and head got better :) I started taking 750mg everyother day and still got little headaches. I haven't figured out the right dosage for me...every womans tollerance will be different. But I would not recommend taking it everyday. I did read about one woman who takes 500mg/day for 16 days then takes 2 weeks off. When I try it I'll update my review.
All in all this product did what it was supposed to do I just have to figure out whats right for me.

text: Had it about a month when it failed completely.... It made a lot of noise, but stopped doing anything. Out of curiosity, I opened the case and found that the the design of the unit has a major fatal flaw. To create the vibration, the unit uses an electro-magnet to pull the massage head one direction, but movement the other direction is accomplished by a piece of soft-steel bent at a 90 degree angel acting as a return spring. As with any soft metal, this rapid back and forth movement causes this piece of metal to break at the 90 degree bend. Apparently, to save money, Wahl uses this method rather than a second coil for movement the other direction. I was actually sort of shocked to see this inept design and wonder about the engineering Wahl's other products.

title: My Somnolent Sidekick, My Secret Weapon Against the Forces of Brightness
text:
Among the most difficult times and places to sleep comfortably is during the early morning hours on a chartered bus. Many times in my journey as a college and professional athlete did I find myself in just such a scenario: confronted with the noise of the road, the loudness of movies being played, the uncomfortable seats, and, of course, the brightness of the outside light coming in at every large window. Added to these nuisances was the fact that I am one of the population of people for whom sleep is next to impossible in places that are not my bed.

Enter the Wrap-a-Nap into my life in 2010, and everything changed. The noise of the road and of movies was drastically muffled and reduced, and in my eyes the brightness of light was replaced by the calm of perfect darkness.

What's more--much more--is the X-Factor of softness and comfort with which the Wrap-a-Nap graces its wearer. This is what really sold me on this. The beautiful effectiveness of the Wrap-a-Nap is, almost inexplicably, more than the sum of its parts as a noise-reducer and light-blocker. The WAN cradles your head in a plush embrace, the fleecy shell and the soft filling are the stuff of which dreams-over-the-road are made.

There is a distinct satisfaction you feel when you try out the WAN in a place you crave sleep but have been habitually denied it. And then suddenly the forces of wakefulness--from within and without--fall under the Wrap-a-Nap's mighty powers of somnolence. I'm not kidding. Try it, and you will see; and then you'll want to log onto Amazon yourself and write a review like this for the WAN.

My days of athletics and bus-travel have ended, but my use of the Wrap-a-Nap continues. It's effective in any travel setting whatsoever. I also use it for naps on the couch in the living room, when the sun comes through my window in bed in the morning, and even at night when I'm trying to sleep and I need a little help nodding off. This thing goes around my forehead, I grab the iPad to read a bit, and before I know it I'm lulled into dreams. I love this thing, and I will always have one. The depth of sleep it ushers in is just too profound to go without.

title: Easy meal replacement, doesn't taste bad but doesn't taste good.
text:
I've been drinking Soylent now for a few months every day for lunch. I am impressed I haven't gotten sick of the taste yet. Some of my friends who drink Soylent say they prefer to let it sit overnight in the blender bottle to thicken the shake. I myself like drinking it immediately after shaking it. I felt that the thicker it was the worse it tasted. When you drink it immediately after shaking it, it's more like water.

The only true con I am not a fan of is that sometimes it gives me diarrhea. It used to happen a lot more frequently when I started drinking it and now it might only happen once every two weeks. However, that gives me anxiety and I am not sure I will continue to drink it for lunch if I stop working from home and return to an office.

Overall, I enjoy the simplicity of this shake thing being my meal. I spend less money than I would going to the store buying intricate ingredients for a meal. Many times before I would have frozen meals for lunch and this feels healthier at least.

title: Compatible with my Samsung Gear Neo 2
text:
One of the pins in the clasp of my Samsung Gear Neo 2 watch band came undone after a year of use. When I looked up replacements, they were all either metal or leather, neither of which I wanted. They were also all very masculine-looking. When I saw this colorful band by French Bull, I decided to try it because I liked that it was very colorful, but not a stereotypical feminine design (pink or floral).

A lot of the negative reviews of the product state that the decal peels off the band after limited use. WITHit answered in one of the Q&A about the design on the product they sell is molded silicone. I can confirm that their answer is correct. The band I received yesterday is designed with molded silicone as opposed to a cheap, plastic overlay.

Installation was a breeze and took less than a minute. The silicone band is lighter than my original, plastic band. I'm not a fan of heavy watches for everyday use. With this band, it does not even feel like I'm wearing a watch. There are 13 slots in this band, so it should not be too difficult to get a comfortable fit for most users.

I hope that French Bull/WITHit comes out with more designs. I do not understand why they only market to Pebble users when their bands are compatible with Samsung smart watches and I'm assuming other smart watches. I included a photo of the pin design, so you can tell if the band is compatible with your smart watch.

June 1, 2016 - I took these for the first time yesterday and about 2 hours later I was terribly ill! All told I experienced almost 8 hours of debilitating food poisoning symptoms. I probably should have gone to the ER after my 9th round of vomiting and my 4th round of diarrhea but I persevered. I drank a bottle of Pedialyte, and eventually felt better. I usually pay close attention to product reviews but these vitamins came so highly recommended everywhere (including Amazon) that I didn't bat an eyelash purchasing two bottles! I feel awful today - still fighting my way back from extreme dehydration. This was by far the worst experience of my life. I am very rarely sick, very very rarely vomit (last time was well over a year ago)... I don't know what else there is to say. Now, having read the negative reviews ont he other page, I feel like I epically failed. I can't even imagine what I would have gone through if I had taken the recommended dosage. I only took 2 capsules because I didn't want to take more than 400 mcg of Folic Acid. This page is VERY DECEIVING!!! Today I went searching for better information and the other amazon product page has much more informative reviews. Major quality control issues. Who knows what is actually in these capsules?! I read one review about a chemical smell - and mine smell awful. I thought it was just the kelp ingredient emitting an odour to which I'm not accustomed. Now I think it really is just a major flaw in the production. Check out the other page for these multivitamins please and make a fully informed purchase. I fully regret buying these.

This is lightweight and I can see it being amazing for people with short hair. I definitely don't recommend it for those with long hair.

title: Comfortable and effective for self training
text:
I'm a guy in my 20s, and I've had this product for a few weeks now and can say that it is pretty comfortable for what it's doing. It won't hold you up if you intentionally slouch, but it pulls your shoulders back and serves as a constant reminder to hold your posture. I would definitely follow the recommended wearing times of 20mins-1hr max, as the goal is to train your muscles to hold yourself up, unlike hard braces that don't help you long term. It is very effective and you can feel the results in less than a week as long as you are consistent and build up a good habit.

Just one small downside I have would be that it doesn't help your neck so much since it can't keep your head back, but as long as you are conscious about it and do it yourself, it works very well together with the posture corrector. text:
Have a two month old baby and after a little over a month of use, it would randomly begin to squeak unbearably loud in the middle of the night. Fast forward to today when I attempted to remedy the squeak with some graphite or silicone spray, only to find one of the pivot bolts on the base was wobbly.

The bearing is destroyed on this pivot as evidenced by a single ball bearing pinched between the bent metal "seal" that should've been retaining the ball bearings.

It's essentially useless at this point knowing how unsafe the load bearing pivot is, and at any moment could simply pull out causing mom/dad and baby to fall.

Have contacted seller for a resolution and will update this review accordingly, depending on how it's handled.

Buyer/current owners beware.

EDIT: Seller sent a whole new base to fix the issue. So the product is "meh", but can't complain about the company.

title: As good as I can imagine
text:
Short and sweet:

Used Nutrakey's Innoflex for nearly 2 years prior to switching to this product, Flex Pro ES. This product works great and I'm extremely glad I switched to it.

Quick background:
-I'm 29 years old, about 192-194 lbs. at 6'1" and roughly 9-10 percent bodyfat. I've been weight training consistently since High School when I was playing football at 14 years old. I currently train 6 days per week, in the form two short workouts per day, overall focusing on losing some extra bodyfat (down to 6-8 percent bodyfat). My supplements are limited to a multi vitamin, whey protein, vitamin D and a greens powdered drink mix.

Positives:
-High value: Inexpensive and lasts 2 months when taken per instructions.
-Unique ingredients: Eggshell membrane ? Used joint and tendon boosting supplements for a decade and never heard of doing anything with egg shells other than throwing them in my compost pile. Others may consider the use of "unusual" ingredients a negative thing (see "Unique ingredients" below). I also like the exclusion of glucosamine and chondroiton. Heard some negatives to those ingredients and they're seemingly in every joint/tendon supplement.
-Effectiveness: ingredients work well together and they work fast.
-Ease-of-use: one medium sized pill once per day in the morning.

Negatives:
-Taste: in the perfect world, Flex Pro ES would be a delicious chewable. In comparison to my old joint/tendon supplement, Innoflex by Nutrakey, I didn't like that Innoflex was a drink mix I had to remember to pull out of the cupboard and pour with some water multiple times every day.
-Unique ingredients: listed "Unique ingredients" as a positive above but using unusual/unheard of ingredients in a supplement can be a risky downside.

Effectiveness explained:
-When I switched from Nutrakey's Innoflex to Flex Pro ES, I waited two weeks before officially switching. During the time "off" from using a joint/tendon supplement, my joints started to dry out again (right knee, right elbow). Within about 10 days of starting Flex Pro ES, I noticed a substantial change, mostly the complete cessation of the constant chronic achey knees. The occasional discomfort was still present through 3 weeks and by one month in, I no longer noticed any unusual joint or tendon pain. Those pains would only occur if training intensity was excessive (lifting heavy too often, adding too much high impact conditioning such as running, trying leg movements I don't commonly use such as the reverse lunge).

In summary, Flex Pro ES is a great product for anyone experiencing common achey joints. When I discovered Innoflex by Nutrakey years ago, I thought I found the Holy Grail for joint/tendon supplements and subsequently used it for over 2 years. That has been "one-upped" now by Flex Pro ES and I just ordered my second bottle and will continue to use it. Hopefully, though, the price will stay $26.77 as Flex Pro ES becomes more popular.

title: Remembering the many TV specials of Bob Hope, America's Goodwill Ambassador...
text:
“Thanks for the Memories: The Bob Hope Specials Deluxe Collection” is a DVD box set containing 39 TV specials on 19 discs, including 20 shows not seen since their original broadcast. The Bob Hope specials spanned five decades with Bob providing comedy, music, dancing and big-name guest stars. The shows are culled from over 250 network specials, several in support of the U.S. Armed Forces.

Bob Hope’s career in show business covered stage, radio, motion pictures and television. He made a series of popular “Road” pictures with Bing Crosby between 1940 and 1962, appeared regularly on radio beginning in 1934, was one of the first radio performers to embrace the new medium of television in 1950, and performed extensively for the troops at American army bases and those serving overseas.

This set features guest stars John Wayne, Bing Crosby, Raquel Welch, Desi Arnaz, Jack Benny, Don Rickles, Barbra Streisand, George Burns, Dean Martin, Ann-Margret, Lucille Ball, Steve McQueen, Lola Falana, Tom Jones, Carol Burnett, Angie Dickinson, Andy Williams, Lana Turner, Jayne Mansfield, Redd Foxx, Zsa Zsa Gabor, and many others.

Though there are other DVD releases featuring Bob Hope specials, this is the most complete collection available. A highlight of the shows is Bob’s memorable monologues, which often riffed on contemporary news and personalities, but never were overly political. Noel Coward once wrote in a song lyric about “a talent to amuse.” The phrase can aptly apply to Bob Hope.

Upon opening it I was punched in the face by an overwhelming stench of gasoline - actually more like someone doused it in gasoline then torched the rubber and then doused it in gasoline again. But despite the smell I put it together, no directions but simple enough: 1 long metal rod, 2 wheels, and 2 handles.

After I assembled it I decided to give it a go on the floor - it also comes with a really thin piece of cloth-y material they call a "knee pad". I rolled with it a few times. Seems like it will give you a pretty good workout but I couldn't continue because the smell was really gross. It stuck to my hands. I had to wash, uh... scrub my hands in dish detergent to get the smell out.

I received it Tuesday. It is now Friday afternoon and it is in bathtub soaking in soap water - that's right, it still SMELLS! I was hoping it would air out instead it has poisoned my apartment with its terrible smell. It's on it second soak. The first soak made a little difference. I'm hoping it will at least be usable by this weekend.

I'm usually an idiot with purchases and I threw the box away that night. I should call the company and complain, but again, I'm an idiot. I would give one star but the product itself does have potential to be good, it just has to stop stinking like rubber set on fire.

I'm very sensitive to harsh smells and perfumes so of course I'm nearly dying from the stench. BUT my husband where nothing bothers him is so confused, confounded, disgusted by the way this thing smells - is it just mine?? Has no one received it this way? What the heck! Maybe I should call the seller - it smells like it could kill plants and small animals...

title: Smell Bad, But That Is How It Is Supposed to Smell Like
text:
NAC, or N-Acetyl Cysteine is commonly used to treat acetaminophen overdose by binding to the acetaminophen molecules and preventing it from reacting with hepatic enzymes, which will damage liver. In addition, it can be used to prevent cancer due to its antioxidant GSH or treat collapsed lungs caused by mucus blockage. There are more benefits that NAC has to offer, so if you want to know whether or not it is a good fit for you, I think you would want to read the information on Wikipedia or WebMD.
I got acetaminophen overdosed 2 months ago due to the migraine, which lasted for three days. It was a painful experience that I would never want to go through again. I definitely will always remind myself to eat before taking the medicine and follow the direction. I took the NAC for about a month and I did notice some improvement and the pain intensity started to diminish. I did feel like vomiting sometimes, but I don’t know whether it is the acetaminophen or the side of effect of NAC. Still, I am glad that I received this bottle for free to do the product evaluation. I made a list of pros and cons while taking the NAC, and I hope everything I mentioned below will be helpful for your purchase decision.
Pros:
- The NAC product is made by a company that strictly follows FDA and cGMP (current Good Manufacture Produce), which ensures that the products are safe, pure, and effective. I personally would not use anything that has no FDA or cGMP label on the package.
- It is organic. According to the seller’s answer to one of the question posted on Amazon, synthetic NAC will be really expensive
- NAC can be taken with or without food. Sometimes I find it is very inconvenient that I must eat before I can take pill, especially when I am in a hurry.
- Good price for 6-month supply, and it only requires you to take one pill a day (180 capsules total)
Cons:
- The smell is horrible. There wasn’t a day that I didn’t want to throw up when I tried to swallow it, but I understand that is how it is supposed to smell like.
- The capsule size is big and it is hard to swallow sometimes.
Overall, I think this is a good product that can be taken over a long period of time for different benefits. Even though my symptoms for acetaminophen overdose already went away, I still continue to take it every day so that I have a steady supplement of antioxidant GSH and glutathione. For a good price and an effective supplement like NAC, I would recommend it to other people.

title: Horrible reaction! (but easy return/refund)
text:
Update- I changed this to 3 stars because I was able to easily return for a full refund.

I did tons of research on protein powders trying to find one that would be more easily digestible for me than another whey product I was taking which was from cow's milk. Because I do better digesting goat's milk than cow's milk I thought this product should work well for me and it seemed really clean. I don't know what is going on but I have had a much harder time digesting this than any other protein powder I have tried. It caused TERRIBLE GAS! I tried half doses or less and gave my body a chance to get used to it but it didn't make a difference. After nearly a week of use and miserable bloating and gas I gave up. I can drink goat's milk with no problem (I am able to get it fresh and organic from a neighbor) so I really should not be having this issue. To me that says there is something amiss that is not being disclosed about this product. The goats may be pasture based but that does not mean organic so it could be there is a chemical is something they are eating that is affecting my ability to assimilate this product. Whatever the case may be I just wasted over $50 and it's not like I have money to throw around. My doctor wants me to be taking a liquid protein daily between meals for health condition I am being treated for. But I also have IBS so it's difficult to find something that works well. Still, this was the worst! I did much better with Jay Robb's whey protein than I did with this one. Very disappointed. I am assuming I can't return it but I guess I may as well try. Will update on how that goes.

title: Quality flax seed oil from a reputable source!
text:
Love flax seed for its plethora of health benefits! Love that it's organic! Love the quality! There is absolutely nothing not to love about this product. It came in two days, well packaged with a tamper resistant seal as it should be and it is consumed by my entire family daily. I mix a tsp. in with their oatmeal and occasional afternoon smoothies. I also blend it into peanut butter and honey sandwiches. According to the Flax Council of Canada, there are numerous benefits of which omega-3 is at the top of the list. ALA (alpha-linolenic acid) constitutes 57% of the total fatty acids in flax, making flax the richest source of ALA in the North American diet. People try flaxseed oil for many different conditions, including rheumatoid arthritis and high cholesterol. It is also tried for treating osteoarthritis, anxiety, benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), vaginal infections, dry eyes, “hardening of the arteries” (atherosclerosis), high blood pressure, heart disease, diabetes, and attention deficit-hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). Some people use flaxseed oil as a laxative for constipation, for weight loss, and to prevent breast cancer and prostate cancer. It is also applied to the skin to sooth irritations or soften roughness.

As you can see it has a remarkable amount of uses. This flax seed oil has no taste or odor and is easy on the stomach aiding in digestion. It's a win, win for me and my family. Try and and see for yourself just what it can do for you!

title: So much easier for me!
text:
I recently had an injury that has basically left my right arm pretty useless for the next several months. I'm one of those girls that have naturally wavy hair no matter what I do and the only way to get it nice and straight is with a flat iron. Having my right arm out of commission makes this a pretty impossible task. So when I saw that this brush could also help me straighten my hair I was really interested. I can use this with my left hand and get my hair nice and straight the way I like it. It's so simple to use, and the display that shows you the temperature is really easy to read. There are buttons that will allow you to increase or decrease the temperature so you can get it to exactly what you want. At first I was a little concerned that it might burn me but there are tips to the bristles that don't get hot so that you don't have this issue. It's as simple as plugging in, picking the right temperature and then brush your hair! I do recommend that you work on smaller sections at a time like you would with a flat iron. If you try to do too much at one time it will tame it for sure but not get as straight as you want just because it can't reach the hair underneath. I'm really happy with this and it has definitely helped me in my current situation.
I received this at a discount for my honest and unbiased review, this is 100% my honest opinion after personally trying this brush :)

I started with 1 teaspoon every 4 hours for a week, then the second and third week I did one in the am and one before bed. From the fourth week+, I do 1 teaspoon in water at bedtime. So far, so good and I have been using for about 2 months now. I love it and until I get through this time of my life, I will use this every day to keep the urinary tract clean. One word of caution-you may experience gas and loose stool the first and second week, as this is the "flushing" of the system you need and it may be aggressive for some. This is just what worked for me-tailor the dosage to your body.

title: Nice meter but...
text:
The meter certainly does its job and comes with the necessary calibration regents in two packets and a small screwdriver to turn the calibration adjustment screw while the meter is dipped in the calibration solution. A well padded box is provided to protect the meter and carry the screwdriver and the two calibration regent packets.

What you won't find in the advertising is that the probe must be kept wet when in storage; if it dries out it must be replaced. The probe cap appears to have extra room for the addition of some of the calibration fluid, or some distilled or purified bottled water, to keep the probe wet. The cap seems to be water tight but since water is one of the most difficult fluids to contain only time will tell if it actually is. Since this is the first ph meter I've purchased I'm uncertain if keeping the probe wet is peculiar to this meter or is required of all ph meters.

The display could be larger to allow horizontal display orientation, rather than vertical, to facilitate its' reading, as can be seen on other meters.

title: Money Saver for Work
text:
In my line of work as both a residential and commercial inspector, one of my main tools of the trade is a flashlight. Needless to say I go through a lot of batteries. I have been using the Platinum LSD charger with AA batteries and I always keep 2 sets of batteries - one set of fully charged back ups and a set in the flashlight. I am impressed with how long the charged batteries last in the flashlight. They last nearly as long as new batteries off the shelf. The one thing I did notice though is that the light doesn't gradually get dimmer as the batteries get weaker - it goes pretty quickly. I always keep a spare set in my pocket each day so it isn't a big deal but this can be an inconvenience at times. This is why I didn't give this product 5 Stars.

Another Plus to the charger is it's relatively compact size for a multi-size battery charger. I had a similar one by a competitor and it is extremely large and that tooki up quite a bit more counter and cupboard space compared to the Ray O Vac charging unit.

Finally, there may already be a converter for a car outlet out there for this, but if not, that would pretty much make this a 5 star rating in my book.

title: A must for new tires
text: All new tires come with a coating which has to be removed in order to allow you to use tire dressings to make the tire look blacker.  TUF SHINE is great at cleaning off these silicone coatings and leaving a clean surface to be "dressed".  You need to also buy the Tuf Shine Brush which works perfectly with the cleaner - buy them together.  To use simply spray on a dry tire , let it dwell 30 seconds and then start brushing with medium pressure working your way around the tire.  I start with about 12 sprays on the tire.  You notice a brown mess coming off the tire - spray it away with a hose and start again with a few less sprays of the product - brush vigorously and rinse.  Repeat four or five times per tire until the mixture become white throughout the brushing - this tells you that you got the gunk off.  Make sure to also rinse the brush when you rinse the tire to avoid putting the crap back onto the face of the tire.  You only need to clean the sidewalls and just part of the first tread block - not all of the treads.  To make sure you have enough product to get around all wheels I would apply and rinse each tire 3 times then move on, then go back to the first tire and treat it again...this way you make sure that you have enough product to do 4 to 5 applications to each tire.  Go ahead and use the product up as it having a little left over does you no good.  Then use a good dressing to make your tire blacker and glossier - I like CarPro Perl, easy to apply, not too greasy, and no slinging of product to your paint when you drive your car - some of the greasier products may do this.  Perl is applied with a cheap foam wax applicator - throw them away when you're done.  Two coats of Perl leaves a darker and glossier looking tire and will protect the tire from the suns rays and keep it from turning brown.  You can then maintain once a month by spraying the tires with a very light dish soap solution in a spray bottle, scrubbing lightly with a softer brush, and then rinsing.  Re-apply  two coats of Perl again.  Also, make sure to review Sonax Wheel Cleaner Full Effect which will clean away the iron build up on your brake rotors and calipers and rims.  This will not adversly affect Perl.  Use Sonax first on dry / cool rims and rotors, let turn red (tells you the brake dust has dissolved) then rinse well.  Wipe down rims and apply a good rim sealer - try Poor Boys Rim cleaner - cheap and it works well and lasts.  Then finish off by cleaning the tires and applying Perl.  Your "ride" will look great.  Bon Chance!

title: Not terrible for the price.
text:
I purchased this humidifier about a year ago, and it has seen about 5 months of overnight use during that period.

Pros:
-It was very cheap.
-It does a decent job creating a comfortable level of humidity in a 13 x 15 room.

Cons:
-It was never very quiet to begin with, and now that it is getting older it is getting noisier. Sometimes, especially during the first hour or so of running, it gets REALLY noisy, but for some reason a good whack usually quiets it back down.
-The power light is extremely bright. It is really surprisingly oh-so-bright. If you are planning on using this while you sleep, I recommend putting a piece of electrical tape or something over the light. If you don't, it will probably keep you awake. (I stole this idea from another commenter.)
-The upper half, especially the tank, is very difficult to clean thoroughly. Plan on either soaking the thing in bleachy water every couple of weeks or using a humidifier anti-fungal solution. The base is somewhat easier to clean, but it does have some nooks and crannies you will need to clean with something like a toothbrush.
-Its runtime on a full tank is inconsistent. Sometimes I get eight or nine hours, sometimes I get five or six. Perhaps this is a function of the ambient humidity. I don't know.

title: good, solid, smooth stones
text:
I'm a licensed massage therapist looking to replace an old set. These arrived promptly and safely along with the crock pot I'm using for a stone warmer.

SIZE:
I know I'm not the only massage therapist with larger than normal hands, so it's good to note that the 3 "extra large" I found to be a good large size but the "large" seemed more like medium, "medium" more like small and so on. Smaller stones lose heat faster so it's good that there are more smaller stones.

SHAPE:
all of these stones are beveled on the edges. The shape is more geometric than the natural variations and rounded edges that I'm used to working with. It's more a personal preference than a pro or con.

QUANTITY:
way more stones than you'll use in a single treatment, I like to reheat used stones during a massage thus I have a lot of stones left over from this set. Good when you have more treatments to go before you can wash them, but I find the next warm stone treatment I do with the left over stone is done with all the stones I didn't want to use in the first one.

I could easily see needing more of one size and less of another over time as you do more treatments or find your personal style, but these are a good solid set of stones if you need a starter set. The carrying case (not that I recommend carrying this weighty package around a lot) is really handy. I keep the stones in the case when not in use, but If you're already got a place for them the wooden case looks like it would make a nice tea box to offer your clients.

title: Works just fine
text: This humidifier is a nice size for a small space, just what I needed. It spouts a lot of mist for such a little thing but it is very fine and doesn't leave my rug or blankets damp unless I let it blow in the same direction for hours and hours (and even still, it's very mildly damp, just cool to the touch). If I fill it up all the way before bed, it runs for the majority of the night (somewhere around 6 hours I'd say), which is enough for me. It produces a low hum and occasional gurgle that I find quite soothing and the red  "on" light is not startling to the eye in the dark. As far as maintenance goes, I have emptied it out, wiped off mineral/sediment/dust buildup off of both top and bottom sections, and set it out to dry completely about once a week and it seems to do the job in keeping it clean. I will probably eventually clean it more vigorously with a cleaning solution, but I think a regular wipe down with a paper towel and Q-tip (for the smaller areas and sharp corners) will help prevent a need for a major cleaning. Aside from its primary function of humidifying the air, the shape and color of the machine are quite pleasant and makes for an overall very satisfying product.

title: When they say powerful motor, they mean it!
text:
As with the previous reviewer, I also received the bath spa for Christmas and finally pulled it out from under the tree for a test run. It's amazing how cold that room-temperature air feels coming out of that mat! It felt like I was sitting on a huge refrigerated gel pak or something.
If that wasn't uncomfortable enough, the bath became less of a spa and more of a frightening cauldron! I've got one of those extra large triangle-shaped soaking tubs, so it looks just like the spa tubs except without the bubbles. However, all the other spa baths I've seen and used do not splash the water so far out of the tub that it hits the walls - this Conair mat did! I was afraid at first I had it on the "high" setting, but it was "low" that caused such a stir. The higher setting was, of course, no better. Not that I want to admit this, but I am not a small woman, so I would think that someone normally sized would get thrown around even more and shudder to think of it.
I think I might have been able to get past the cold, but I can't relax while fearing that the water will splash out of the tub and onto the floor, cabinets, walls, etc, so the longest I could use the mat was for less than five minutes a couple of times. I'm hoping we can yet exchange it for another model.

text:
This definitely works! I bought this for restless legs and sleeplessness, and it definitely has helped! It feels a little tacky on your skin until it's fully dry, so I add water to where I apply it to help spread it out more across a larger surface of my body and after about 10 to 15 minutes it feels like it's absorbed / dried.

Longer review ahead:

I've struggled with restless legs, sleepiness, and my heart feeling like it's beating hard when I try to fall asleep at night. When I looked into this more, it seemed to be consistent with a magnesium deficiency.

I work out regularly, and people who are physically active are more likely to have certain mineral deficiencies because of the constant stress they put their body through. I just historically chalked up my issues to working out too hard, But I never put two and two together until my chiropractor and a friend both recommended magnesium supplementation.

Your skin, being the largest organ, readily absorbs what you put on it, and Epsom salt baths are perfect for this as well as going to the beach and swimming in the ocean. Since neither of those are really an option for me at this time, I opted for this lotion and I'm so glad that I did!

title: Best Lumbar Support On The Market
text:
This is it, no need to look further. I've tried other portable lumbar support pillows and memory foam options. This is the best option on the market in my opinion. Like many of you I found this company through Dr. Stuart McGill / Back Mechanic after realizing I needed to have my lumbar region supported at all times to allow my back to heal. I actually own a fancy $1,000 ergonomic desk chair and now place this $30 support over the backrest to provide the support and comfort I need. Don't make the mistake that I did, just buy a crappy office chair and use this support if you are dealing with back pain/ disc issues. This product is unique in that you can place this support anywhere on your spine and adjust it over the course of the day so that your back doesn't get as sore. Nothing else on the market has this level of adjustability and comfort.

I knocked off one star because the little cap on the air pump fell off after one week of use so I've had to rig a temporary solution that still allows the product to function as intended. Although this product is Made in Canada rather than China, the quality is still not there. Still, at this price I'm a huge fan of this product and would recommend back pain sufferers give it a try.

title: That is why Glucosamine HCl is not sold by itself but with other ingredients that provide the sulphur like Chondroitin Sulfate
text:
Why did I select this product?

Glucosamine Sulfate is known to helps cartilage regeneration. Many supplements sold are Glucosamine HCl (hydrochloride) rather than Glucosamine Sulphate. Sulfate is needed to produce cartilage. That is why Glucosamine HCl is not sold by itself but with other ingredients that provide the sulphur like Chondroitin Sulfate. But many physicians consider that Chondroitin takes away the efficacy of the Glucosamine.

A study by ConsumerLab.com showed that many of the glucosamine/ chondroitin supplements do not contain the labeled amounts of ingredients. Also if some pills do not dissolve sufficiently, their ingredients might not be fully available for absorption in the body.

That is why I selected this product in powder and from a company that I begin to trust.

title: In control of my sun exposure
text:
Skin cancer runs in my family, but I found out recently that I am Vitamin D deficient. I bought a SunFriend to balance getting some sun but not enough to burn. So far so good. I got the orange and yellow because it looks like the sun. Surprisingly, it looks pretty good with my outfits despite the bright color. People keep asking me about it, which is pretty cool. The panel of lights takes getting used to, kind of like a 1970s digital watch. The SunFriend.com website has more detailed instructions than the package. The first day I set it to Skin Sensitivity 1 (SS-1), and it seemed too low. Now I set it at SS-4, and I still haven't burned. With practice I'm learning to trust that it really is measuring UV. (Apparently, the sensor was designed at NASA) I push the Check UVA+B button throughout the day, and when the LEDs get near 11, I start planning to put on sunscreen or go inside. Voilà! Easy. I feel more in control of my sun exposure, and don't have to slather on as much chalky white SPF 80 sunscreen. Also, the contact points are all silicone or plastic, so no nickel allergy issue.

Cool product for anyone concerned about skin damage and making enough Vitamin D.

title: Safe to Try
text:
I bought this product as a temporary alternative to his regular ADHD meds because I found myself unable to afford the meds in these economic times! I read all the reviews and knew to expect results and wait about 1 month. It has been 1 month and my 12 year old son reports no changes but I have observed some changes. Although I will say he was expecting the effects to be like his 20-30 ml. regular pill, he has improved his focus on his assignments and made them a priority at home! I can compare the two because my son did have a few months of NOT being on Synaptol or regular ADHD meds during the school year and he was distracted, unfocused and did sloppy homework. The teachers in his middle school were not happy with him. Now, however, he has at least earned his way back to being an accomplished student (meaning he completes everything on time!) and has raised his grades. I believe the effects are subtle enough that even he did not realize he is focusing a lot better than before. Synaptol is in no way like regular ADHD pills. There is no appetite suppression nor changes in personality. It is not that strong. However, it is a safe way to test on your child because the recommended dosage is 1 ml. twice a day. It is clear with no taste.

I plan to keep him on Synaptol through the summer. I combined this with Omega Fish Oil in liquid Form. My son likes that both Synaptol and the Fish Oil (google Barlean's or others that come flavored) are in liquid form. He hates pills.

title: Color Me Zed
text:
Zombies are the "it" monster/creature right now, and everybody thinks they can do zombies. I'm here to tell you that nobody does zombies like Tommy does zombies. Tommy's zombies are some of the most gore caked, oozing, shuffling stiffs you'll find this side of an old George Romero Movie. But it's not just the torn-off cheeks, missing appendages, and copious consumption of brains that make Tommy's zombies better than all the rest. No, it's the former humanity that is clearly visible in every zombie that he draws. It's the sheer terror you feel for some poor sap foolish enough to have been caught by a group of these marching maggot piles. It's the texture lovingly (menacingly?) rendered in each image that sets Tommy's work apart from the rest of the mindless z-heard.
If you have any love for zombies, the macabre, or horror movies in general then this book is for you. This book is for the twisted little kid inside us all that used to stay up late to sneak and watch those bloody gory movies that your parents said said would scar you for life. It's full of dark humor, pretty (gross) images and activities! what more could you want?

We started with the steamer on high and the timer set to 45 minutes however for my sister it was too hot for her forcing her head out of the dome so we put the setting on low and everything was perfect from there. The only reason I would not give this product a perfect 5-star is because the instructions are not clear what-so-ever. It takes more common sense and playing around with the pieces like a puzzle to get the stand together. The instructions were not clear for the "water catcher", I guess that's what its called, because when I read the reviews before purchasing and noticed a lot of people saying that there were problems with it leaking, but in my case there was a rubber spout where water did come out from however there is a separate piece that slides into place to catch that water from the rubber spout. That was no where in the instructions and my sister and I had to figure out for ourselves. Other than that the product works great so far, today is day one, and I would recommend the purchase for a friend.

Update 12/15/2020
I am still using this hair steamer a few times a week & it continues to work perfectly. I have had a white build up on the coil where the water heats. But it’s not affecting the steamer at all. I’m very happy with this purchase!

title: The next gen model is definitely more comfortable
text:
A bit of context: I wrote a review that was mediocre regarding the previous version of these nose vents. They were rigid and uncomfortable. I moved on with my life and then recently was contacted by the manufacturer to give the new version a try. I reluctantly agreed because of my previous experience and they sent me a gift card to purchase the next gen vents. The process worked perfectly and I received the product. I then received several annoying emails from the seller pushing me to quickly post a review (which I am obviously doing but made clear to them that I would not post a review until I tried the product out and that I could provide an honest account). I informed the seller that I would not post a glowing review simply because they offered another go with their product. After that exchange, the annoying emails ceased.

Now on to the review: I settled on the smooth and smaller gauge vents. There are two sizes for the smooth version and two sizes for the vents with ribbing. I was surprised that the vents were more comfortable and flexible when I laid down. It does take some time to get cozy with rubber vents stuck up your nose but I felt 'good' with the fit and placement. They flex when you lay down but.do not close up nor do they feel like your nose if being pushed violently open. I fell asleep well and throughout the night woke up, adjusted, and fell back to sleep with little awareness of the vents being in. I am not sure if they have helped with my snoring yet but I will update this post when I have more information.

Overall, these feel much better when in use than previous versions and do not hinder sleep. I would recommend trying these vents given the price point and improved comfort level.

The customer service, although responsive and good with follow through, is definitely annoying when they feel they are owed something on an arbitrary timeline and seemingly pushy at times.

title: I wear these at any loud bar or show
text: For the price, they are fantastic. There are a couple things I wish were better, but I seriously think that next level of quality would cost wayyy more than these. I’ve owned them now for a little over a year, and I try to always bring them with me when I go out to clubs/loud bars and showsAnd if I forget them I seriously regret it. I use the large silicone tips same as with any earbuds I buy as they seal perfectly fine and are more comfortable than the foam. The foam blocks more sound and bass, but the trouble of getting the right fit with the foam usually outweighs how quick and easy I can get them in my ears with the silicone tips so I keep the foams in the bag that comes with them for when I encounter extreme levels of volume or bass. Btw the little bag is way better for pocket storage than the hard metal/plastic solutions other earplugs use. They are low profile and seriously comfortable. Music at a show sound just about exactly the same when they are in my ears, vs out, except for when there is a lot of bass. And I mean future bass/dubstep levels of bass so they do the job just fine otherwise. They are a little more conspicuous than some other options, but definitely more comfortable as fit better than the eargasm plugs which are the only other ones I’ve tried. In the future I’d hope to buy something that blocks bass a little better so I can hear the rest of the music but in most situations these are perfect. Loop is sleek but still a little odd looking, maybe I’m just self conscious but they perform very well and I wear them to every loud bar and show I can.
